# Split Tender Payments
Quick Reference
  * **Purpose:** Understand CCG's orchestration and status handling for split tender payments.
  * **Key Scenarios:** Sale and Pre-AUTH, with all possible success/failure/cancellation flows.
  * **Use:** Refer to the table for status mapping, the diagram for process flow, and the scenario list for outcome summaries.


Business Use Case
  * Business Rules: [**Payment Business Rules**](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/business-use-case/payment/common-use-case/)
  * Sale Transaction:
    * [**Card + Card**](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/business-use-case/sale/card_card_transactions/)
    * [**Card + ACH**](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/business-use-case/sale/card_ach_transactions/)
    * [**ACH +ACH**](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/business-use-case/sale/ach_ach_transactions/)


## CCG Split Tender Payment Process[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/payments/#ccg-split-tender-payment-process "Direct link to CCG Split Tender Payment Process")
PROCESSING MODELS
**Processing Models**
CCG uses different processing models based on the payment method combination:
#### Processing Models by Payment Method Combination[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/payments/#processing-models-by-payment-method-combination "Direct link to Processing Models by Payment Method Combination")
CCG employs different processing strategies based on the payment method combination to optimize for reliability and transaction integrity:
Payment Combination | Processing Model | Rationale  
---|---|---  
**Card + Card** | Parallel | Both card payments can be processed simultaneously for faster completion and can be reliably cancelled if needed  
**ACH + ACH** | Parallel | Both ACH payments can be initiated simultaneously for consistent processing timeline  
**Card + ACH** | Sequential | Card is processed first, then ACH only if card succeeds, because ACH cancellation is not reliable in production  
**Sequence Diagram - Parallel Processing (Card+Card or ACH+ACH)**
The diagram below illustrates how CCG orchestrates split tender payments with similar payment method types:
Payment Method 2Payment Method 1CCG PlatformMerchantPayment Method 2Payment Method 1CCG PlatformMerchant Validate both payment methodspar[Parallel Payment Processing]Auto-capture both paymentspar[Parallel Capture]No auto-capturealt[Sale Type][PreAuth Type]alt[Both Payments Success][Payment 1 Success, Payment 2 Fails][Payment 1 Fails, Payment 2 Success][Both Payments Fail]Split Tender Payment RequestProcess Payment 1Process Payment 2Payment 1 SuccessPayment 2 SuccessCapture Payment 1Capture Payment 2Capture ResponseCapture ResponseSplit Payment COMPLETEDSplit Payment AUTHORIZEDPayment 1 SuccessPayment 2 FailureCancel Payment 1Cancel ResponseSplit Payment FAILEDPayment 1 FailurePayment 2 SuccessCancel Payment 2Cancel ResponseSplit Payment FAILEDPayment 1 FailurePayment 2 FailureSplit Payment FAILED
**Sequence Diagram - Sequential Processing (Card+ACH)**
The diagram below illustrates how CCG sequentially processes Card + ACH split tender payments:
ACH ProcessorCard ProcessorCCG PlatformMerchantACH ProcessorCard ProcessorCCG PlatformMerchant Validate both payment methodsAuto-capture card paymentFinal status when ACH settlesNo auto-capturealt[Sale Type][PreAuth Type]alt[Both Payments Success][ACH Payment Fails]ACH payment not initiatedalt[Card Authorization Success][Card Authorization Fails]Split Tender Payment RequestProcess Card Payment FirstCard Authorization ResponseProcess ACH PaymentACH ResponseCapture Card PaymentCapture ResponseSplit Payment ACCEPTED (ACH pending)Split Payment AUTHORIZEDCancel Card AuthorizationCancel ResponseSplit Payment FAILEDSplit Payment FAILED
  1. **Initial Request** : CCG receives a split tender payment request
  2. **Pre Condition** : Payment Methods under split tender should be validated before initiating payment request to Stripe
  3. **Processing Model Selection** :
     * **Parallel Processing** : For Card + Card and ACH + ACH (same payment method type)
     * **Sequential Processing** : For Card + ACH (different payment method types)
  4. **Outcome Determination** : Based on payment type (Sale vs Pre-AUTH) and success/failure of each payment
  5. **Action Orchestration** :
     * For successful payments, CCG initiates captures (for Sale type)
     * For partial successes, CCG cancels the successful payment to maintain transaction integrity
     * For failures, CCG retries critical operations (captures/cancellations) as needed
  6. **Webhooks** :
     * Webhooks will be triggered only for Final Transaction level


* * *
## Payment Flows[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/payments/#payment-flows "Direct link to Payment Flows")
CCG supports the following payment flow types for split tender transactions:
Split Tender Transaction Limitation
  * All split payment flows require consistent transaction types. You cannot mix Sale and Pre-AUTH payment types within the same split tender transaction.
  * When using ACH as one payment method in a split tender transaction, any accompanying card payment must use the Sale transaction type rather than PreAuth due to ACH processing limitations


  1. [**Sale**](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/sale-transactions/) - Pre-Auth + Capture
     * CCG automatically initiates capture immediately after authorization
     * Both payment methods must be successfully authorized before capture begins
  2. [**Pre-AUTH**](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/pre-auth-transactions/) - Pre-Auth + Merchant Capture
     * CCG performs authorization only, funds are held but not transferred
     * Merchant must explicitly request capture at a later time
  3. [**Partial Auth**](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/pre-auth-transactions/partial-authorization/) - Pre-Auth (Partial) + Merchant Capture
     * System accepts partial authorizations when full amount isn't available
     * Remaining balance should be handled by merchant
     * Merchant must explicitly capture the authorized amounts


* * *
## Key Split Tender Scenarios[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/payments/#key-split-tender-scenarios "Direct link to Key Split Tender Scenarios")
Scenario | Description | Final Outcome  
---|---|---  
1 |  **Full Success (Sale)** : Both payments authorize and capture successfully | COMPLETED  
2 |  **Partial Failure** : Payment 1 succeeds, Payment 2 fails - CCG cancels Payment 1 | FAILED  
3 |  **Initial Failure** : if initial validation fails on payment method, Refer **[Business Rules](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/business-use-case/payment/common-use-case/)** | FAILED  
4 |  **Capture Retry** : Both payments authorize, but capture has temporary issue - CCG retries | COMPLETED after retry  
5 |  **Pre-AUTH Success** : Both payments authorize successfully (Pre-AUTH type) | AUTHORIZED (Merchant action required)  
6-7 |  **Cancellation Scenarios** : Various cases where CCG needs to cancel a payment | FAILED (with potential retries)  
* * *
## Idempotency and Safety[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/payments/#idempotency-and-safety "Direct link to Idempotency and Safety")
CCG ensures idempotency for all split tender transactions:
  * Each transaction includes a unique `idempotencyKey` to prevent duplicate processing
  * If a retry occurs with the same idempotency key, the original response is returned
  * All payments carry a reference to the parent transaction ID for complete traceability
  * In case of system interruptions, payments can be safely recovered using the original transaction ID


* * *
## Transaction Processing Timelines (TAT)[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/payments/#transaction-processing-timelines-tat "Direct link to Transaction Processing Timelines \(TAT\)")
Understanding the processing timeline for different payment methods is crucial for implementing effective split tender strategies and setting appropriate customer expectations. This section details the typical processing windows for both Stripe and CCG across various payment scenarios.
Key Processing Metrics
  * **Card Payments** : Typically complete within **2-3 seconds**
  * **ACH Payments** : Generally take **1-4 business days** to fully process
  * **Split Tender Transactions** : Completion time is determined by the slower payment method


### Payment Method Processing Windows[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/payments/#payment-method-processing-windows "Direct link to Payment Method Processing Windows")
**Stripe Processing Timeline**
#### Card Payments - Success Path[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/payments/#card-payments---success-path "Direct link to Card Payments - Success Path")
Event | Typical Timing | Example  
---|---|---  
Request submission | T+0 | `15:52:55`  
`payment_intent.created` | T+0 (immediate) | `15:52:55`  
`payment_intent.succeeded` | T+1-3 seconds | `15:52:57`  
#### Card Payments - Failure Path[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/payments/#card-payments---failure-path "Direct link to Card Payments - Failure Path")
Event | Typical Timing | Example  
---|---|---  
Request submission | T+0 | `22:55:02`  
`payment_intent.created` | T+0 (immediate) | `22:55:02`  
`payment_intent.failed` | T+1-2 seconds | `22:55:03`  
#### ACH Payments[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/payments/#ach-payments "Direct link to ACH Payments")
Event | Typical Timing | Example  
---|---|---  
Request submission | T+0 | `21/07/2025, 18:36:20`  
`payment_intent.created` | T+0-1 seconds | `21/07/2025, 18:36:21`  
`payment_intent.processing` | T+1-2 seconds | `21/07/2025, 18:36:21`  
`payment_intent.succeeded` | T+1-4 business days | `25/07/2025, 08:08:22`  
### CCG End-to-End Processing Timeline[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/payments/#ccg-end-to-end-processing-timeline "Direct link to CCG End-to-End Processing Timeline")
**Guest Card Payment Processing Timeline**
Event | Timestamp | Duration  
---|---|---  
Payment Initiated | `2025-07-26T15:52:55.039Z` | T+0  
Payment Request to Stripe | `2025-07-26T15:52:57.103Z` | T+2.064s  
Received `payment_intent.created` event | `2025-07-26T15:52:57.496Z` | T+2.457s  
Received `payment_intent.succeeded` event | `2025-07-26T15:52:57.433Z` | T+2.394s  
Payment moved to completed | `2025-07-26T15:52:57.471Z` | T+2.432s  
**Total Processing Time** : ~2.4 seconds
**Wallet Payment Processing Timeline**
Event | Timestamp | Duration  
---|---|---  
Payment Initiated | `2025-07-26T18:28:45.797Z` | T+0  
Payment Request to Stripe | `2025-07-26T18:28:47.239Z` | T+1.442s  
Received `payment_intent.created` event | `2025-07-26T18:28:47.684Z` | T+1.887s  
Received `payment_intent.succeeded` event | `2025-07-26T18:28:47.507Z` | T+1.710s  
Payment moved to completed | `2025-07-26T18:28:47.543Z` | T+1.746s  
**Total Processing Time** : ~1.75 seconds
**Card + ACH Sequential Processing**
For Card + ACH transactions, CCG implements a sequential approach because:
  1. **Cancellation Reliability** : ACH cancellation is not reliable in production environments
  2. **Risk Mitigation** : Processing the card first prevents scenarios where an ACH payment would need to be cancelled
  3. **Customer Experience** : Prevents scenarios where customers would have funds withdrawn via ACH but still have a failed transaction

## Special Cases[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/payments/#special-cases "Direct link to Special Cases")
Special Use Cases
#### 3DS Authentication Handling[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/payments/#3ds-authentication-handling "Direct link to 3DS Authentication Handling")
**3DS Authentication Handling**
#### Agent-Initiated Sessions[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/payments/#agent-initiated-sessions "Direct link to Agent-Initiated Sessions")
  * If an Agent initiates split payments and any card requires 3DS authentication, the entire payment must fail
  * System will return `3DS_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED` error code with appropriate message
  * Agents should be advised to use non-3DS requiring payment methods


#### Customer-Initiated Sessions[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/payments/#customer-initiated-sessions "Direct link to Customer-Initiated Sessions")
  * **3DS Challenge Failure** :
    * If customer fails the 3DS challenge, retry will be allowed for each payment method
    * Retry count follows standard logic (initial attempt + maximum 4 retries)
    * System tracks retry attempts across both payment methods


#### Single Payment Processing[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/payments/#single-payment-processing "Direct link to Single Payment Processing")
**Single Payment Processing**
  * When only one payment method is used but submitted through split tender API:
    * System automatically optimizes to "Sale" flow with if requested paymentType is SALE
    * Reduces latency and potential for dangling authorizations


#### Timeout Handling[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/payments/#timeout-handling "Direct link to Timeout Handling")
**Timeout Handling**
  * Split tender transactions have longer timeout thresholds
  * If a timeout occurs after first payment succeeds, system will automatically attempt to cancel the authorized amount
  * Recovery process automatically runs to ensure no dangling authorizations




# Split Tender Payment Business Rules
## Overview[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/business-use-case/payment/common-use-case/#overview "Direct link to Overview")
Split tender transactions let customers pay for a single purchase using two different payment methods (e.g., Card + Card, Card + ACH, or ACH + ACH). This increases flexibility, supports higher-value purchases, and reduces cart abandonment due to insufficient funds on a single payment method.
Scope
  * **Mode:** Pay with Stored Card
  * **API Endpoint:** `v2/payments`
  * **API Permission:** `merchant`
  * **Maximum Number of Payment Methods:** 2
  * **Payment Type:** Sale
  * **Transaction Type:** Card/ACH + Card/ACH


Out-Of-Scope
  * **Mode:** One Time Pay/ Pay and store
  * **API Endpoint:** `v2/sessions`
  * **API Permission:** `merchant-pci`
  * **Payment Type:** PRE-AUTH


## Early Failures[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/business-use-case/payment/common-use-case/#early-failures "Direct link to Early Failures")
This section outlines the validation rules that apply to split tender transactions.
Error Codes
Error Type | Description | Impact  
---|---|---  
⚠️ **INVALID_REQUEST** | The request will not be accepted | Transaction is rejected immediately  
🚨 **PAYMENT_METHOD_ERROR** | Request will be accepted but error will be returned on polling | Transaction is accepted initially but fails during processing  
⛔ **FORBIDDEN** | MerchantTransaction Id cannot be reused | Transaction is rejected due to duplicate ID  
### Payment Type Validation[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/business-use-case/payment/common-use-case/#payment-type-validation "Direct link to Payment Type Validation")
**NOT ACCEPTABLE**
  * **Mixed Payment Type Compatibility:**
    * If `BANK ACCOUNT + CARD` payment methods are used together, payment type requested cannot be `PRE_AUTH`.
    * Pre-authorization is not applicable for ACH Direct Debit transactions.
    * **Example:** A request with payment type `PRE_AUTH` and payment methods Bank Account + Card will be accepted initially but will fail during processing.
  * **Payment Type Consistency:**
    * Both payment methods must use the same payment type.
    * **Example:** Cannot mix `SALE` for one payment method with `PRE_AUTH` for the other.


### Payment Method Validation[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/business-use-case/payment/common-use-case/#payment-method-validation "Direct link to Payment Method Validation")
**INVALID REQUEST**
  * **Unique Payment Methods:**
    * The same payment method cannot be used for both payments in a split tender transaction.
  * **Maximum Payment Methods:**
    * Limited to exactly two payment methods per transaction.


**PAYMENT_METHOD_ERROR**
Important Note
Each payment method in a split tender transaction is individually validated according to these rules. If any payment method fails validation, the entire transaction will fail.
  * **Valid Payment Methods:**
    * Both PM1 and PM2 must be in valid status to initiate the transaction.
  * **Availability in Customer Wallet:**
    * Both payment methods must be available in the CCG wallet and associated to respective customer.
  * **Payment Method ID Required:**
    * Each payment must have a valid paymentMethodId.
  * **Payment Method Configuration:**
    * The requested payment method type must be enabled in the merchant's configuration.
      * For example, if a merchant is configured to accept only card payments, a request for a bank account payment method will be rejected.
    * **Manufacturer Card Configuration:**
      * The manufacturer card must be enabled in the merchant's configuration.
  * **Payment Type:**
    * Payment Type should be `SALE` if any one of the payment method is `BANK_ACCOUNT`
  * **Early Warning API** **Early Warning API check is not applicable for stored bank accounts**
    * Early Warning API is primarily designed for real-time validation of newly entered bank account details to detect fraud or invalid accounts at the point of entry.
    * Stored bank accounts have already passed initial validation and have a history of successful use, reducing the risk of fraud or invalidity.
    * Re-validating stored accounts with Early Warning API can lead to unnecessary friction and false positives for returning users.
    * Industry best practices recommend using Early Warning API for new or updated bank account entries, not for accounts already on file.
    * Ongoing risk monitoring for stored accounts is handled through transaction monitoring and return/NOR events, not through repeated Early Warning API checks.


### Amount Validation[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/business-use-case/payment/common-use-case/#amount-validation "Direct link to Amount Validation")
**INVALID REQUEST**
  * **Explicit Amounts:**
    * Merchants must explicitly specify the amount for each payment method.
    * **Example:** If total is $100, specify $60 for first payment and $40 for second payment.
  * **Parent-Level Amount Consistency:**
    * The total transaction amount (parent level) must exactly match the sum of individual payment amounts.
    * This requirement enables automatic fallback to single payment if split tender fails.
    * **Example:** If parent amount is $100, payment amounts could be $70 + $30, but not $60 + $30.
  * **Amount Limit:**
    * Total transaction amount must be ≥ 2 cents
    * Each individual payment amount must be ≥ 1 cent (Stripe minimum requirement)
    * **Example:** Cannot split $1.00 as $0.005 + $0.995


### Merchant Transaction ID[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/business-use-case/payment/common-use-case/#merchant-transaction-id "Direct link to Merchant Transaction ID")
**INVALID REQUEST**
  * **Uniqueness:**
    * Each split tender transaction must have a unique Merchant Transaction ID to ensure accurate tracking and reconciliation.
  * **Reprocess:**
    * Merchant Transaction ID can be reused only when the parent transaction status is in `FAILED` status.
    * If the ID is reused for a failed transaction, only specific fields may be overridden (see Idempotency Handling [here](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/retry-strategies/#merchant-transaction-id-idempotency-handling)).


### Consent Requirement[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/business-use-case/payment/common-use-case/#consent-requirement "Direct link to Consent Requirement")
**INVALID REQUEST**
  * **Bank Account Consent:**
    * If either payment method is a `BANK_ACCOUNT`, user consent is required.
    * Consent must be explicitly collected and provided in the API request.
    * Missing consent for bank account payments will cause the transaction to be rejected.


### Existing Validation Use Cases[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/business-use-case/payment/common-use-case/#existing-validation-use-cases "Direct link to Existing Validation Use Cases")
important
**Existing Payment Validations**
All validations for single payments also apply to split tender transactions:
  * **Payment Object:** [Payment Object Validation](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/developers/convenient-checkout-api/common-error-codes/payment-object-error-codes/)
  * **Customer Object:** [Customer Object Validation](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/developers/convenient-checkout-api/common-error-codes/customer-object-error-codes/)
  * **Agent Object:** [Agent Object Validation](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/developers/convenient-checkout-api/common-error-codes/agent-object-error-codes/)
  * **Consent Object:** [Consent Object Validation](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/developers/convenient-checkout-api/common-error-codes/consent-object-error-codes/)
  * **Payment Details:** [Payment Details Object Validation](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/developers/convenient-checkout-api/common-error-codes/payment-details-object-error-codes/)
  * **Authorization:** [Payment Authorization Error Codes](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/convenient-checkout-api/payment-error-codes/payment-auth-errors/)


### Transaction Management Restrictions[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/business-use-case/payment/common-use-case/#transaction-management-restrictions "Direct link to Transaction Management Restrictions")
CAPTURE/CANCEL/REFUND TRANSACTION RESTRICTIONS
Learn More
Refer **[Transaction Management](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/transaction-management/)** for more details
  * **Capture Transactions** :
    * Merchants are not allowed to capture sale transactions
    * Only CCG can capture sale transactions
  * **Cancel Transactions** :
    * Merchants are not allowed to cancel sale transactions if any payment method in the split tender is a `CARD`
    * Only CCG can cancel sale transactions involving card payments
    * Merchants cannot cancel ACH transactions if the transaction is in `PENDING` status
      * For ACH+ACH combinations, both transactions must be in `ACCEPTED` status for cancellation
      * For CARD+ACH combinations, cancellation is not allowed since the payment type is `SALE`
  * **Refund Transactions** :
    * Merchants are not allowed to refund any transactions if any payment method in the split tender is in `PENDING` status :::




# Polling
Scope
  * **API Scope:** `merchant`
  * **API Enpoint:** `v2/payments/{paymentId}` , `v2/payments/merchantTransactionId={merchantTransactionId}`
  * **Interaction mode:** `API`


## Polling Guidelines for Split Tender Transactions[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/payments/polling/#polling-guidelines-for-split-tender-transactions "Direct link to Polling Guidelines for Split Tender Transactions")
For Split Tender transactions, polling is only allowed at the parent transaction level. This ensures a consistent and atomic view of the entire transaction, including all payment components.
### Key Points[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/payments/polling/#key-points "Direct link to Key Points")
  * **Parent Transaction Only:** All polling requests should be made using the parent transaction ID.
  * **Consolidated Status:** The response will include the overall transaction status and individual statuses for each payment component.
  * **Complete Information:** The polling response contains detailed information about all payments in the split tender transaction.


### Not Supported[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/payments/polling/#not-supported "Direct link to Not Supported")
  * Polling for individual payment components within a split tender transaction is not supported.
  * Using component-level IDs for polling will not return the correct consolidated transaction status.


Best Practice
To maintain transaction integrity and ensure accurate status reporting, always poll using the parent transaction identifier.
## Status Combinations[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/payments/polling/#status-combinations "Direct link to Status Combinations")
When polling for Split Tender transactions, the parent transaction status is determined by the status of the individual payment components. Below are the possible status combinations you may encounter:
note
Parent Transaction Status `AUTHORIZED` is applicable only for `PRE_AUTH` Payments
**Success Scenario**
Payment 1 Status | Payment 2 Status | Parent Transaction Status | Description  
---|---|---|---  
AUTHORIZED (Card) | AUTHORIZED (Card) | PENDING | Both card payments are authorized but not yet captured in SALE TRansaction  
CAPTURE_INITIALIZED (Card) | COMPLETED (Card) | CAPTURE_INITIALIZED | One card is in capture initialization, other is completed  
COMPLETED (Card) | COMPLETED (Card) | COMPLETED | Both card payments have been successfully completed  
AUTHORIZED (Card) | ACCEPTED (ACH) | ACCEPTED | Card is authorized and ACH is accepted but still processing  
ACCEPTED (ACH) | ACCEPTED (ACH) | ACCEPTED | Both ACH payments are accepted and processing  
CANCELLED | CANCELLED | CANCELLED | Both card payments were cancelled (for PRE-AUTH)  
**Pre-AUTH Scenarios**
Payment 1 Status | Payment 2 Status | Parent Transaction Status | Description  
---|---|---|---  
AUTHORIZED (Card) | AUTHORIZED (Card) | AUTHORIZED | Both card payments are authorized but not yet captured  
CAPTURE_INITIALIZED (Card) | CAPTURE_INITIALIZED (Card) | CAPTURE_INITIALIZED | Both card payments are in capture initialization  
CANCEL_INITIALIZED (Card) | CANCEL_INITIALIZED (Card) | CANCEL_INITIALIZED | Both card payments are in cancel initialization  
**Failures Scenarios**
Payment 1 Status | Payment 2 Status | Parent Transaction Status | Description  
---|---|---|---  
AUTHORIZED (Card) | PAYMENT_METHOD_FAILED | PAYMENT_METHOD_FAILED | One card authorized but the other failed  
PAYMENT_METHOD_FAILED (Card) | NA (ACH) | PAYMENT_METHOD_FAILED | Card payment failed, ACH not attempted  
AUTHORIZED (Card) | FAILED (ACH) | FAILED | Card authorized but ACH failed; card will be cancelled  
FAILED (ACH) | COMPLETED (ACH) | FAILED | One ACH failed while another succeeded  
PAYMENT_METHOD_FAILED | PAYMENT_METHOD_FAILED | PAYMENT_METHOD_FAILED | Both card payments failed  
FAILED (ACH) | FAILED (ACH) | FAILED | Both ACH payments failed  
**Rollback Scenarios**
Payment 1 Status | Payment 2 Status | Parent Transaction Status | Description  
---|---|---|---  
CANCEL_INITIALIZED | PAYMENT_METHOD_FAILED | CANCEL_INITIALIZED | Roll back initiated for authorized payment  
CANCELLED | PAYMENT_METHOD_FAILED | PAYMENT_METHOD_FAILED | One of the payments cancelled  
## Polling Response[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/payments/polling/#polling-response "Direct link to Polling Response")
When polling a Split Tender transaction, the response will include:
Response Structure
The polling response maintains the same structure as the original payment response, making it easy to track status changes over time.
  1. The overall parent transaction status
  2. Individual status for each payment component
  3. Payment method details for each component
  4. Any error information for failed components
  5. Metadata and timestamps for tracking purposes


### Metadata[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/payments/polling/#metadata "Direct link to Metadata")
#### Transaction-Level Metadata[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/payments/polling/#transaction-level-metadata "Direct link to Transaction-Level Metadata")
  * **Definition:** Key-value pairs that apply to the entire transaction. These fields are shared across all payments within the transaction.
  * **Common Fields:**
    * `checkoutId`
    * `merchantId`
    * `merchantTransactionId`
    * `merchantName`
    * `ccg_processor`
    * `merchantGroupId`
    * Merchant-supplied metadata (e.g., `orderId`)


info
**Additional Fields for Rollback/Refund:** If a refund is initiated as part of a rollback, the metadata will also include:
  * `rollBackType`: Set to `CCG_AUTOMATED_REFUND` for rollback-initiated refunds.
  * `refundId`: The unique identifier of the refund transaction.


#### Payment-Level Metadata[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/payments/polling/#payment-level-metadata "Direct link to Payment-Level Metadata")
  * **Definition:** Key-value pairs for information specific to an individual payment within a transaction.
  * **Common Fields:**
    * `referenceId`
    * `ccg_paymentMethodId`
    * `ccg_paymentmethodlast4`
    * Any transaction-level metadata (including merchant-supplied fields)


> **Note:** Payment-level metadata = Individual payment metadata + All transaction-level metadata (including merchant-supplied fields)
Merchant-supplied metadata is automatically applied at both the transaction and payment levels.

# Wallet
## Overview[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/wallet/#overview "Direct link to Overview")
A **digital wallet** in CCG enables users to securely store and manage multiple payment methods for online transactions, including:
  * **Credit or debit cards**
  * **Bank accounts**
  * **Cryptocurrency**


By linking preferred payment methods to their wallet, users enjoy a faster and more convenient checkout experience.
When making a payment through a gateway, the wallet transmits stored payment information securely for authorization and processing. This eliminates the need to manually enter payment details for each transaction, enabling **One-Click Payments** and improving both convenience and security for users and merchants.
* * *
## Types of Wallets in CCG[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/wallet/#types-of-wallets-in-ccg "Direct link to Types of Wallets in CCG")
CCG provides two wallet types for merchants:
  * [**Enterprise Wallet**](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/wallet/enterprise-wallet/): For customers with an enterprise identity, supporting advanced account management and integration.
  * [**Local Wallet**](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/wallet/local-wallet/): For customers without an enterprise identity, allowing secure storage and use of payment methods.


important
Wallets are available only for authenticated users in CCG. Each wallet is uniquely identified by a `walletCustomerId`.


# Transaction Management
## Overview[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/transaction-management/#overview "Direct link to Overview")
Transaction Management in a Split Tender payment context refers to the system's ability to handle, track, and manage payment transactions that use multiple payment methods. This document outlines the permissions and restrictions for key transaction operations (capture, cancel, refund) based on payment method combinations and transaction states.
## Capture Restrictions[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/transaction-management/#capture-restrictions "Direct link to Capture Restrictions")
Transaction capture refers to the process of finalizing a previously authorized payment for settlement.
**CAPTURE TRANSACTION RESTRICTIONS**
Payment Status
  * Parent Payment Status should be `AUTHORIZED` to initiate capture transaction


Transaction Type | Payment Methods | Merchant | CCG | Condition  
---|---|---|---|---  
Sale | Any | ❌ | ✅ | CCG automatically captures sale transactions  
Pre-AUTH | Any | ✅ | ❌ | Merchant must explicitly capture pre-auth transactions  
## Cancel Restrictions[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/transaction-management/#cancel-restrictions "Direct link to Cancel Restrictions")
Transaction cancellation refers to stopping a transaction that has been initiated but not yet settled. Different payment method combinations have specific rules for cancellation.
**CANCEL TRANSACTION RESTRICTIONS**
Payment Status
  * Parent Payment Status should be `AUTHORIZED` or `ACCEPTED` to initiate capture transaction


Transaction Type | Payment Methods | Merchant | CCG | Condition  
---|---|---|---|---  
Sale | Card + Card | ❌ | ✅ | Only CCG can cancel sale transactions with cards  
Sale | ACH + ACH | ✅ | ✅ |  **Merchant Initiated:** Only if both ACH transactions are in `ACCEPTED` status.  
**CCG Initiated:** No status dependency for roll back process  
Sale | Card + ACH | ❌ | ✅ | Merchants are not allowed to cancel sale transactions with mixed payment methods  
Pre-AUTH | Card + Card | ✅ | ❌ | Merchants can cancel pre-authorization transactions  
## Refund Restrictions[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/transaction-management/#refund-restrictions "Direct link to Refund Restrictions")
Refunds are the process of returning funds to a customer after a COMPLETED transaction. Refund capabilities depend on the payment status and methods used.
**REFUND TRANSACTION RESTRICTIONS**
Payment Status | Payment Methods | Merchant | CCG | Condition  
---|---|---|---|---  
PENDING | Any | ❌ | ✅ | If any payment method is in FAILURE status, CCG issues refund as part of rolling back  
PENDING | Any | ❌ | ✅ | If any payment is pending under a split tender transaction  
✅ COMPLETED | Any | ✅ | ❌ | Only merchants can initiate refunds for ✅ COMPLETED transactions  
## Ambiguous Payment Status[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/transaction-management/#ambiguous-payment-status "Direct link to Ambiguous Payment Status")
STRIPE DASHBOARD INITIATED OPERATIONS
The Mixed payment method status scenarios only occur when captures or cancellations are initiated directly from the Stripe dashboard rather than through the CCG platform. In these cases, CCG is responsible for maintaining transaction integrity.
**Transaction Integrity Impacts:** Merchant-initiated transaction operations have significant implications for transaction integrity within the system. Since these operations can modify the state of financial transactions, they must be carefully controlled and monitored through the CCG platform rather than directly in Stripe.
### Mixed Payment State Scenarios[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/transaction-management/#mixed-payment-state-scenarios "Direct link to Mixed Payment State Scenarios")
****Mixed Payment State Scenarios****
Reconcilation Process
  * **CCG Responsibility** : When a capture or cancellation event is received from Stripe (initiated from the Stripe dashboard), CCG will automatically initiate **[RollBack Process](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/rollback-strategies/#rollback-process)** to maintain integrity. Merchants do not need to take any action in these scenarios.
  * **No Merchant Handling** : Merchants are not required to handle refunds or reconciliation for Ambiguous status split tender transactions resulting from Stripe dashboard operations. CCG will process all necessary refunds and actions.


#### COMPLETED Vs FAILED/CANCELLED COMBINATIONS[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/transaction-management/#completed-vs-failedcancelled-combinations "Direct link to COMPLETED Vs FAILED/CANCELLED COMBINATIONS")
**Use Cases**
Scenario | Payment Method 1 | Payment 1 Status | Payment Method 2 | Payment 2 Status | CCG Action | Payment 2 Status After CCG Action | Final Transaction Status  
---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---  
1 | CARD | 🚫 CANCELLED (via Stripe) | ACH | ✅ COMPLETED | CCG automatically issues refund for ✅ COMPLETED ACH payment | 💰 COMPLETED | 🚫 CANCELLED  
2 | CARD | ✅ COMPLETED (captured via Stripe) | ACH | ❌ FAILED | CCG issue refund for ✅ COMPLETED CARD payment if required | ❌ FAILED | ❌ FAILED  
3 | ACH | 🚫 CANCELLED (via Stripe) | ACH | ✅ COMPLETED | CCG automatically issues refund for ✅ COMPLETED ACH payment | 💰 COMPLETED | 🚫 CANCELLED  
4 | CARD | 🚫 CANCELLED (via Stripe) | CARD | ✅ COMPLETED (captured via Stripe) | CCG automatically issues refund for ✅ COMPLETED CARD payment | 💰 COMPLETED | 🚫 CANCELLED  
#### ACCEPTED/AUTHORIZED Vs FAILED COMBINATIONS[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/transaction-management/#acceptedauthorized-vs-failed-combinations "Direct link to ACCEPTED/AUTHORIZED Vs FAILED COMBINATIONS")
**Use Cases**
Scenario | Payment Method 1 | Payment 1 Status | Payment Method 2 | Payment 2 Status | CCG Action | Payment 2 Status After CCG Action | Final Transaction Status  
---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---  
5 | CARD | 🚫 CANCELLED (via Stripe) | ACH | ⏳ ACCEPTED | CCG automatically initiates cancel on PENDING ACH payment | 🚫 CANCELLED | 🚫 CANCELLED  
6 | CARD | 🚫 CANCELLED (via Stripe) | ACH | ⏳ ACCEPTED | CCG automatically initiates cancel on PENDING ACH payment but cancellation failed | 🚫 CANCEL_FAILED | 🚫 CANCEL_FAILED  
7 | CARD | 🚫 CANCELLED (via Stripe) | ACH | ❌ FAILED | No additional action needed | ❌ FAILED | ❌ FAILED  
8 | ACH | 🚫 CANCELLED (via Stripe) | ACH | ❌ FAILED | No additional action needed | ❌ FAILED | ❌ FAILED  
9 | CARD | 🚫 CANCELLED (via Stripe) | CARD | ✅ AUTHORIZED | CCG automatically initiates cancel on AUTHORIZED CARD payment | 🚫 CANCELLED | 🚫 CANCELLED  
#### COMPLETED Vs ACCEPTED/PENDING/AUTHORIZED COMBINATIONS[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/transaction-management/#completed-vs-acceptedpendingauthorized-combinations "Direct link to COMPLETED Vs ACCEPTED/PENDING/AUTHORIZED COMBINATIONS")
**Use Cases**
Scenario | Payment Method 1 | Payment 1 Status | Payment Method 2 | Payment 2 Status | CCG Action | Payment 2 Status After CCG Action | Final Transaction Status  
---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---  
10 | CARD | ✅ COMPLETED (captured via Stripe) | CARD | ✅ AUTHORIZED | CCG automatically initiates capture on AUTHORIZED CARD payment | ✅ COMPLETED | ✅ COMPLETED  
11 | CARD | ✅ COMPLETED (captured via Stripe) | CARD | PENDING | CCG wait for capturable state and initiates capture on AUTHORIZED CARD payment | ✅ COMPLETED | ✅ COMPLETED  
12 | ACH | ✅ COMPLETED | ACH | ACCEPTED | CCG wait for ACH Final Event and Then send notification if Success | ✅ COMPLETED | ✅ COMPLETED  
### Handling Guidelines for Mixed Status Transactions[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/transaction-management/#handling-guidelines-for-mixed-status-transactions "Direct link to Handling Guidelines for Mixed Status Transactions")
  1. **Stripe Dashboard Operations** : These mixed status scenarios occur exclusively when captures or cancellations are initiated directly from the Stripe dashboard instead of through CCG.
  2. **CCG Automated Handling** : Upon receiving a capture or cancellation event from Stripe, CCG will automatically issue refunds or take necessary actions on the other payment method to maintain transaction integrity. No merchant intervention is required.
  3. **Merchant Responsibilities** :
     * Avoid initiating captures or cancellations directly from Stripe dashboard
     * Monitor split tender transactions for mixed status scenarios only for informational purposes
     * Split Payments in Stripe will have a flag to indicate the same through metadata.




# Abandoned Payments
## Overview[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/sessions/abandonedpayments/#overview "Direct link to Overview")
When a user closes their browser or loses connection during a split tender payment, the system can be left in an ambiguous state—one payment may be completed while the other fails. This section details the risks, system behaviors, and automated recovery mechanisms for handling such unattended or abandoned transactions.
BUSINESS RISK
**Critical Edge Case:** Browser closure or session loss during split tender processing can result in:
  * Asymmetric transaction states (one payment succeeded, one failed)
  * Financial reconciliation issues
  * Customer confusion about charged/reserved funds
  * Potential duplicate payment attempts


## Session Timeout & Abandonment[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/sessions/abandonedpayments/#session-timeout--abandonment "Direct link to Session Timeout & Abandonment")
CCG sessions have configurable timeout settings to automatically handle abandoned transactions:
Session Type | Default Timeout | Maximum Duration | Configurable  
---|---|---|---  
UI Session | 15 minutes | 30 minutes | Yes  
info
When sessions time out, CCG's automated recovery process will initiate to resolve any pending or partially completed transactions.
## Abandonment Scenarios[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/sessions/abandonedpayments/#abandonment-scenarios "Direct link to Abandonment Scenarios")
**Common Abandonment Patterns**
Scenario | Description | Risk Level  
---|---|---  
Browser Closure | User closes browser/tab during payment processing | High  
Connection Loss | Network interruption during transaction processing | High  
Session Timeout | User leaves page idle for extended period | Medium  
## Browser Closure During Split Payment[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/sessions/abandonedpayments/#browser-closure-during-split-payment "Direct link to Browser Closure During Split Payment")
**Browser Closure Flow Analysis**
Payment Method 2Payment Method 1CCGBrowserUserPayment Method 2Payment Method 1CCGBrowserUser Critical Moment: Browser Closed by UserAsymmetric State DetectedPM1: AUTHORIZED ✅PM2: FAILED ❌Session: ABANDONEDConsistent Final StatePM1: CANCELLED ✅PM2: FAILED ❌Transaction: FAILEDInitiates Split PaymentSplit Payment RequestProcess Payment 1AUTHORIZED ✅Process Payment 2PAYMENT FAILED for insufficient funds ❌Closes Browser/TabConnection TerminatedAutomated Recovery: Cancel AuthorizationAuthorization CancelledMark Transaction as FAILED
## State Analysis & Resolution[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/sessions/abandonedpayments/#state-analysis--resolution "Direct link to State Analysis & Resolution")
**Transaction States & Automated Resolution**
Component | Initial Status | Automated Resolution | Final Status | Timeframe  
---|---|---|---|---  
Payment Method 1 | AUTHORIZED | Cancel authorization | CANCELLED | Within 15 min  
Payment Method 2 | FAILED | No action required | FAILED | Immediate  
UI Session | TERMINATED | Session cleanup | EXPIRED | 15 min timeout  
API State | PARTIAL | Roll back successful parts | FAILED | Within 15 min  
Customer Funds | RESERVED | Funds released | AVAILABLE | 1-5 business days*  
*Fund availability timing depends on the financial institution's processing schedule.
## CCG Automated Recovery Process[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/sessions/abandonedpayments/#ccg-automated-recovery-process "Direct link to CCG Automated Recovery Process")
CCG implements a robust automated recovery process to handle abandoned split tender transactions:
  1. **Detection** :
     * Session timeout/cancel triggers
  2. **Analysis** :
     * Identify asymmetric payment states
     * Evaluate transaction completeness
     * Determine appropriate rollback strategy
  3. **Resolution** :
     * Cancel authorizations for successful payment methods
     * Mark transaction as FAILED
     * Log recovery actions for audit trail
     * Generate merchant notification if configured
  4. **Notification** :
     * Send webhook event `TRANSACTION_FAILED` to merchant




# Webhooks Management
Split tender transactions require special handling of webhooks to ensure merchants receive complete and accurate information about the transaction. This document outlines how webhooks are managed for split tender payments.
## Consolidated Transaction Approach[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/webhooks/#consolidated-transaction-approach "Direct link to Consolidated Transaction Approach")
  * A single webhook payload represents the entire transaction with detailed status information for both payment components
  * The consolidated approach reduces webhook volume while maintaining transaction integrity


### Transaction Status Logic[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/webhooks/#transaction-status-logic "Direct link to Transaction Status Logic")
  * **Component-Level Statuses** : Each payment component has its own individual status
  * **Transaction-Level Status** : Determined by a cascading ruleset:
    * If any component is `FAILED` → Transaction status is `FAILED`
    * All components must be `COMPLETED` for transaction status to be `COMPLETED`

**Webhook Triggering Based on Transaction Status**
Webhooks for split tender transactions are triggered according to the overall transaction status, which is determined by the statuses of the individual payment components. The key rules are:
  * **PAYMENT_SUCCEEDED** : A webhook is sent when all payment components are successfully completed. The transaction status is set to COMPLETED, and a PAYMENT_SUCCEEDED event is triggered.
  * **PAYMENT_FAILED** : If any payment component fails, a webhook is sent with the transaction status set to FAILED. The PAYMENT_FAILED event is triggered, and the webhook includes detailed status and error information for each component.
  * **PAYMENT_AUTHORIZED** will be sent only for CARD + CARD transactions in the Pre-Authorization (Pre_AUTH) flow. This event indicates that both card components have been successfully authorized, but the transaction is not yet finalized.
  * **PAYMENT_ACCEPTED** will be sent when both ACH components are accepted in ACH + ACH transactions, or in CARD + ACH transactions when the card is authorized and the ACH is accepted. This event provides early notification that the payment process has started, but does not guarantee final success.
  * **PAYMENT_CANCELLED** : If all components are cancelled (e.g., by merchant action), a webhook is sent with the transaction status set to CANCELLED and a PAYMENT_FAILED event, with both payment statuses marked as CANCELLED.


Merchants should use the transaction status and individual payment statuses in the webhook payload to determine the appropriate next steps for order processing and reconciliation.
## Lifecycle Event Webhooks[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/webhooks/#lifecycle-event-webhooks "Direct link to Lifecycle Event Webhooks")
### Transaction Webhooks[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/webhooks/#transaction-webhooks "Direct link to Transaction Webhooks")
**Transaction Webhook Events**
PAYMENT_FAILED
PAYMENT_FAILED event is not final if another attempt is made with the same merchant transaction id. It is only final when no further attempts are possible.
**Event Name** | **Card + Card: Pre-AUTH** | **Card + Card: Sale** | **ACH + ACH: Sale** | **Card + ACH: Sale**  
---|---|---|---|---  
PAYMENT_AUTHORIZED | ✅ Intermediate | ❌ | ❌ | ❌  
PAYMENT_SUCCEEDED | ✅ Final | ✅ Final | ✅ Final | ✅ Final  
PAYMENT_ACCEPTED | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ Intermediate | ✅ Intermediate  
PAYMENT_FAILED | ✅ Intermediate/Final* | ✅ Intermediate/Final* | ✅ Intermediate/Final* | ✅ Intermediate/Final*  
PAYMENT_CANCELLED | ✅ Final | ❌ | ❌ | ❌

Important
Merchants must properly handle webhooks for split tender transactions to ensure accurate order processing and financial reconciliation. Failing to properly process these webhooks may result in orders being incorrectly marked as paid or unpaid.


# Split Tender Refunds
Quick Reference
  * **Purpose:** Understand CCG's handling of refund requests for split tender payments.
  * **Key Scenarios:** Complete refunds, partial refunds, multiple refunds, and handling of refund failures.
  * **Use:** Refer to the table for status mapping and outcome summaries for different refund scenarios.


## CCG Split Payments Refund Process[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/refunds/#ccg-split-payments-refund-process "Direct link to CCG Split Payments Refund Process")
**Sequence diagram**
The diagram below illustrates how CCG orchestrates split tender refund requests:
Payment Method 2Payment Method 1CCG PlatformMerchantPayment Method 2Payment Method 1CCG PlatformMerchant Validate refund eligibilityalt[Both Refunds Successful][One Refund Failed]Calculate refund distributionalt[Both Refunds Successful][One Refund Failed]Check remaining balance on each paymentSkip payments with no remaining balancealt[Payment 1 Has Remaining Balance][Payment 2 Has Remaining Balance]alt[Full Refund (No Amount Specified)][Partial Refund (Amount Specified)][Subsequent Refund]Split Tender Refund RequestProcess Full Refund for Payment 1Payment 1 Refund ResponseProcess Full Refund for Payment 2Payment 2 Refund ResponseREFUNDEDPARTIAL_REFUNDProcess Partial Refund for Payment 1Payment 1 Refund ResponseProcess Partial Refund for Payment 2Payment 2 Refund ResponseREFUNDEDPARTIAL_REFUNDProcess Refund for Remaining BalancePayment 1 Refund ResponseREFUNDEDProcess Refund for Remaining BalancePayment 2 Refund ResponseREFUNDED
  1. **Refund Request** : Merchant initiates a refund request for completed split tender payments
  2. **Orchestrated Refund** :
     * CCG can process full refunds for both payments
     * CCG can handle partial refunds based on specified amounts
     * For subsequent refunds, CCG processes refunds only against payments that have a remaining balance.
     * CCG implements amount validation to skip payments that have been fully refunded.
  3. **Outcome Handling** :
     * For successful refunds of both payments, status is REFUNDED
     * For failures on one payment, a PARTIAL_REFUND status is returned
     * For multiple partial refunds, CCG tracks remaining balances to ensure proper refund distribution
  4. **Merchant Decision Point** : When one payment refund fails permanently, merchants may need to decide whether to issue unlinked refunds or credits


This approach ensures that split tender refunds are handled with appropriate intelligence around partial and multiple refunds while providing clear status information for exception cases.
* * *
## Key Split Tender Refund Scenarios[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/refunds/#key-split-tender-refund-scenarios "Direct link to Key Split Tender Refund Scenarios")
Scenario | Description | Final Outcome  
---|---|---  
1 |  **Full Refund** : Both payments refunded successfully | REFUNDED  
2 |  **Partial Failure** : One payment refunds successfully, one fails | PARTIAL_REFUND  
3 |  **Partial Amount Refund** : Specific amounts refunded from both payments | REFUNDED  
4 |  **Multiple Refunds** : Subsequent refunds on remaining balance | REFUNDED  
5 |  **Refund Exceeds Available** : Requested refund amount exceeds available balance | REFUND_FAILED  
6 |  **Disputed payments** : Refund is not possible on Disputed payments | PARTIAL_REFUND  
7 |  **Subsequent Refunds with Balance Tracking** : Skip payments with no remaining balance | REFUNDED

## Processing Considerations[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/refunds/#processing-considerations "Direct link to Processing Considerations")
**Special Considerations**
  1. **Timing Differences** :
     * Card refunds typically process within 1-3 business days
     * ACH refunds can take 3-5 business days to complete
     * Split tender refunds with different payment methods may complete at different times
  2. **Refund Limitations** :
     * Individual refunds cannot exceed the original payment amount for each payment method
     * Total refunds across multiple refund requests cannot exceed original payment amounts
     * System maintains a running balance for each payment method to enforce these limits
  3. **Failure Handling** :
     * If one payment method refund fails but the other succeeds, a PARTIAL_REFUND_SUCCESS status is returned
     * Merchants should review partial refunds and may need to issue unlinked refunds for failed portions
  4. **Status Reporting** :
     * Webhooks provide status updates as refunds progress through the system
     * Individual payment method refund statuses are tracked separately
     * Overall refund status reflects the combined outcome of all payment methods
  5. **Pending Refunds** :
     * **Refunds from Stripe available balance** : Refunds are issued from available balance of connect account, stripe holds refunds if available balance is less than refund amount. stripe will issue refund once available balance becomes sufficient. Stripe will debit from connect account bank account if available balance falls short if `autodebit` is set as true in settings. Incase of `autodebit` false, there are chances of refund to be kept on hold which will have significant impact on issuing refunds under split tender transactions.


## Refund Validation Enhancements[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/refunds/#refund-validation-enhancements "Direct link to Refund Validation Enhancements")
CCG should implement comprehensive validation rules specifically designed for split tender refunds to ensure proper handling of complex scenarios. See [**Existing Refund validation**](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/developers/convenient-checkout-api/payments/refunds/#refund-validation-flow) for more information
Balance Tracking for Split Tender Refunds
CCG must implement its own amount validation to properly handle multiple refunds across split tender payments.
Balance Tracking flow
Payment 2 ($50)Payment 1 ($100)CCG PlatformMerchantPayment 2 ($50)Payment 1 ($100)CCG PlatformMerchant Initial Payment State: Payment 1 ($100), Payment 2 ($50)Track remaining balancesUpdated Balance: Payment 1 ($0), Payment 2 ($25)Check remaining balancesSkip Payment 1 (No balance)Final Balance: Payment 1 ($0), Payment 2 ($0)1st Refund (With Amounts): P1=$100, P2=$25Refund $100SuccessRefund $25SuccessREFUNDED2nd Refund (No Amount Specified)Refund remaining $25SuccessREFUNDED
**Balance Tracking Implementation Details**
  * **Initial Refund** : CCG records the original payment amounts and tracks remaining balances after each refund
  * **Subsequent Refunds** : System consults remaining balances before processing additional refunds
  * **Zero Balance Handling** : Payments with zero remaining balance are automatically skipped


Payment Status validation
  * **Valid Status Requirements** : Refunds are only permitted for payments in `COMPLETED` status
  * **Capture Validation** : Refund should be restricted for uncaptured payments
  * **Cancellation Check** : Payments already in `CANCELLED` status cannot be refunded
  * **Expiration Validation** : Refunds must be requested within the timeframe allowed by the payment processor (typically 180 days)


#### Status Validation Matrix[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/refunds/#status-validation-matrix "Direct link to Status Validation Matrix")
Payment Status | Refund Allowed | Notes  
---|---|---  
COMPLETED | ✅ Yes | Standard refund flow applies  
AUTHORIZED | ❌ No | Payment must be captured first  
CANCELLED | ❌ No | Payment already reversed  
FAILED | ❌ No | No successful payment to refund


# Retry Strategies
## Overview[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/retry-strategies/#overview "Direct link to Overview")
Split tender transactions divide a single purchase across multiple payment methods. This document outlines the robust retry strategies and recovery mechanisms Convenient Checkout Gateway (CCG) employs to maximize success and minimize cost when part of a split tender transaction fails.
Key Benefits of Retry Strategy
  * **Higher Success Rate** : Systematic retry approach leads to improved overall transaction success rate
  * **Better Customer Experience** : Automatic handling of transient failures reduces customer friction
  * **Comprehensive Rollback** : If one payment fails, all successful payments are properly reversed
  * **Transparent Notifications** : Merchants receive detailed information about failures and rollbacks


* * *
## Retry Mechanism[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/retry-strategies/#retry-mechanism "Direct link to Retry Mechanism")
**Business Rules**
  * **Pre-Condition** : Merchant is allowed to retry only when parent transaction is marked as `FAILED` status and Retry Attempts are available.
  * **Maximum Retry Attempts** : Total of **5 attempts** allowed across the entire transaction lifecycle.
  * **Payment Finality Rule** : If any one of the payments reaches a final state that is not `COMPLETED` (either `FAILED` or `CANCELLED`), the other payment will be automatically rolled back and the attempt will be marked as failed.
**Roll Back Transaction**
    * If any payment method fails, the entire transaction under split tender will be rolled back to allow customer to pick a different set of payment methods. Refer [**RollBack Strategies**](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/rollback-strategies/) for more details.
    * **Asynchronous Rollback Process** :
      * Refunds initiated as part of rollback for split tender transactions are handled asynchronously by the system. The merchant will be notified of rollbacks and can initiate retries as needed.
      * Cancellations are real-time and communicated as part of transaction.
  * **Merchant Notification** : Merchants will be notified with detailed rollback information when a transaction fails, including which payments were affected and the reason for failure.
  * **All Retries Exhausted** : If the payment cannot be moved to `COMPLETED` or `FAILED` within the maximum retry limit, the transaction will be canceled to maintain transaction integrity.
  * **Single Payment Fallback** : If transaction fails on split tender, customer or merchant will be allowed to submit payment with a single payment method.
  * **All-or-Nothing Retry:** Selective retry of only the failed payment is not supported. If any payment in a split tender transaction fails, the entire transaction must be retried from the beginning with a new set of payment methods if desired.
    * This approach allows the customer to select different payment methods and reallocate the payment amounts as needed for the retry attempt, providing flexibility in resolving the failed transaction.
**Example: All-or-Nothing Retry with Different Payment Methods and Amounts**
    * Suppose a customer splits a $100 purchase between two cards:
      * Card A: $60
      * Card B: $40
    * If Card B fails (e.g., insufficient funds), the entire transaction is rolled back. On retry, the customer can:
      * Choose Card A: $50
      * Choose Card C: $50
**This flexibility allows the customer to adjust both the payment methods and the allocation of amounts to maximize the chance of success on the next attempt.**


Retry Attempt Tracking
**Retry Attempt Counter**
Each time a transaction fails and is retried with the same merchantTransactionId, the system increments the attempt counter:
  1. Initial transaction attempt (count: 1)
  2. First retry after failure (count: 2)
  3. Second retry after failure (count: 3)
  4. Third retry after failure (count: 4)
  5. Fourth and final retry (count: 5)


If the fifth attempt fails, no further retries will be permitted for that transaction ID.
* * *
### Retry Flow for Split Tender Failures[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/retry-strategies/#retry-flow-for-split-tender-failures "Direct link to Retry Flow for Split Tender Failures")
**Retry Flow Diagram**
Payment Method 2Payment Method 1CCG PlatformMerchantPayment Method 2Payment Method 1CCG PlatformMerchant Initial Split Payment AttemptPayment 2 failed, rolling back Payment 1Retry Attempt (Same Transaction ID)Auto-capture both paymentsalt[Sale Type][PreAuth Type]Split Payment Request (Attempt 1)Process Payment 1✅ SUCCESSProcess Payment 2❌ FAILED (Insufficient Funds)Cancel Payment 1 AuthorizationAuthorization CancelledPAYMENT_FAILED (All Rolled Back) + Rollback InformationRetry Request (Same merchantTransactionId)Process Payment 1✅ SUCCESSProcess Payment 2✅ SUCCESSCapture Payment 1Capture SuccessCapture Payment 2Capture SuccessCOMPLETEDAUTHORIZED
## Merchant Transaction Id Idempotency Handling[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/retry-strategies/#merchant-transaction-id-idempotency-handling "Direct link to Merchant Transaction Id Idempotency Handling")
  * **Idempotency Keys** : Always use the same merchantTransactionId when retrying a failed transaction. This ensures that retries are recognized as part of the same transaction and prevents duplicate processing.
  * If the same Merchant Transaction ID is submitted again:
    * ⚠️ If the original payment is in a non-failed status, the new request will be **rejected** to prevent duplicate processing.
      * ⛔ If the original payment is in a failed status and retry attempts are exhausted, the request will be **forbidden**.
      * 🚧 If the original payment is in a failed status and retry attempts are not exhausted, only the following parameters are allowed to be overridden:
        * Amount at individual payment level
        * Payment Method


Preserved Parameters
Fields that cannot be overridden during retries
The following fields will **not** be overridden when merchant retries with the same merchant transaction id:
  * `statementDescriptorSuffix`
  * `description`
  * `paymentType`
  * `partialAuthorization`
  * `authorizeFlag`
  * `payment metadata`
  * `parent amount`


## Retry Best Practices for Merchants[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/retry-strategies/#retry-best-practices-for-merchants "Direct link to Retry Best Practices for Merchants")
**Integration Recommendations**
  * **Error Handling** : Always check the transaction status and error codes before retrying
  * **Progressive Backoff** : Implement increasing delays between retry attempts (e.g., 1s, 2s, 4s)
  * **Timeout Management** : Set appropriate timeouts for payment operations (recommended: 30s)
  * **Fallback Strategies** : Consider offering single-payment fallback option when split tender fails


* * *
## Transient Failures Retry Mechanisms[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/retry-strategies/#transient-failures-retry-mechanisms "Direct link to Transient Failures Retry Mechanisms")
### Retry for Stripe Calls[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/retry-strategies/#retry-for-stripe-calls "Direct link to Retry for Stripe Calls")
When any API call to Stripe fails, CCG automatically attempts to recover through systematic retries:
Retry Configuration for Stripe Timeouts and Too Many Requests
  * Maximum of 3 retry attempts
  * Exponential backoff: 2s, 4s, 8s (total ~14s)
  * Automatic retry for idempotent operations only

# Rollback Strategies
## Overview[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/rollback-strategies/#overview "Direct link to Overview")
This document outlines the comprehensive rollback strategy for the Convenient Checkout Gateway (CCG) when handling split tender payments. The rollback strategy ensures transaction integrity and consistent final states when one payment in a split tender transaction fails or requires cancellation.
Key Concepts
  * **Transaction Integrity** : Ensuring that a split tender transaction either completes fully or fails completely
  * **Rollback** : The process of reversing a successful payment when its counterpart in a split tender transaction fails
  * **Recovery Mechanisms** : Processes to handle cases where the rollback itself encounters issues


## Core Principles[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/rollback-strategies/#core-principles "Direct link to Core Principles")
CCG's split tender rollback strategy follows these core principles:
  1. **Atomic Transactions** : Split tender payments are treated as a single atomic unit - they must either succeed completely or fail completely
  2. **Automated Handling** : The system automatically initiates rollbacks without merchant intervention
  3. **Timely Resolution** : Rollbacks are initiated immediately upon detection of a failure
  4. **Clear Status Communication** : Transaction status clearly reflects partial or complete failures
  5. **Financial Protection** : Customer funds are protected through appropriate cancellation or refund mechanisms


## Rollback Scenarios[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/rollback-strategies/#rollback-scenarios "Direct link to Rollback Scenarios")
### Card + Card[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/rollback-strategies/#card--card "Direct link to Card + Card")
**Card + Card Rollback Use Cases**
Failed Payment | Successful Payment | Rollback Action | Final Transaction Status | Webhooks  
---|---|---|---|---  
Card 1 | Card 2 (Authorized) | Cancel authorization on Card 2 | ❌ FAILED | `TRANSACTION_FAILED`  
Card 2 | Card 1 (Captured) | Issue refund for Card 1 | ❌ FAILED |  `TRANSACTION_FAILED`, `PAYMENT_REFUNDED`  
**Notes:**
  * CCG ensures that if one card payment fails, the other is either cancelled (if authorized) or refunded (if captured), maintaining transaction integrity.
  * Merchants receive clear webhook notifications for each action.


### Card + ACH[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/rollback-strategies/#card--ach "Direct link to Card + ACH")
**Card + ACH Rollback Use Cases**
Failed Payment | Successful Payment | Rollback Action | Final Transaction Status | Webhooks  
---|---|---|---|---  
Card | ACH (Accepted) | Cancel ACH transaction | ❌ FAILED | `TRANSACTION_FAILED`  
Card | ACH (Completed) | Issue refund for ACH payment | ❌ FAILED |  `TRANSACTION_FAILED`, `PAYMENT_REFUNDED`  
ACH | Card (Authorized) | Cancel Card authorization | ❌ FAILED | `TRANSACTION_FAILED`  
ACH | Card (Captured) | Issue refund for Card payment | ❌ FAILED |  `TRANSACTION_FAILED`, `PAYMENT_REFUNDED`  
**Notes:**
  * ACH cancellations are only possible if the payment is still in an accepted state; otherwise, a refund is issued.
  * Card authorizations are cancelled if ACH fails before card capture.
  * All actions are automated and merchants are notified via webhooks.


### ACH + ACH[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/rollback-strategies/#ach--ach "Direct link to ACH + ACH")
**ACH + ACH Rollback Use Cases**
Failed Payment | Successful Payment | Rollback Action | Final Transaction Status | Webhooks  
---|---|---|---|---  
ACH 1 | ACH 2 (Accepted) | Cancel ACH 2 transaction | ❌ FAILED | `TRANSACTION_FAILED`  
ACH 1 | ACH 2 (Completed) | Issue refund for ACH 2 payment | ❌ FAILED |  `TRANSACTION_FAILED`, `PAYMENT_REFUNDED`  
**Notes:**
  * CCG attempts to cancel the second ACH if possible; otherwise, a refund is issued.
  * All actions are logged and communicated to merchants.


## Rollback Process[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/rollback-strategies/#rollback-process "Direct link to Rollback Process")
When a payment method fails in a split tender transaction, CCG automatically rolls back any successful payments to ensure atomicity and customer protection. The process includes both refunds and cancellations, depending on the payment status and method.
### Refunds[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/rollback-strategies/#refunds "Direct link to Refunds")
**Refunds Process**
If a payment is already completed, CCG initiates a refund. Merchants receive a detailed `PAYMENT_REFUNDED` webhook with:
  * **Child Payment Id** : The refunded payment
  * **Parent Transaction Id** : The split tender transaction
  * **Refund Reason** : `CCG ROLLBACK`
  * **Amount** : Full refund amount
  * **Status** : Refund process status


Refund Notifications
  * Merchants must handle `PAYMENT_REFUNDED` webhooks with reason `CCG ROLLBACK` to keep transaction states accurate.
  * No `PAYMENT_CANCELLED` event is sent for cancellations initiated by CCG as part of rollback.


[PAYMENT REVERSAL](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/rollback-strategies/#payment-reversal)
If a refund is processed as a reversal:
  * `PAYMENT_REVERSED` notification will be sent. See [**Refunds and Reversals**](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/rollback-strategies/#refunds-and-reversal) for details.
  * Reversals are only possible for card transactions.


### Cancellation[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/rollback-strategies/#cancellation "Direct link to Cancellation")
**Cancel Process**
If a payment is still in an accepted or authorized state, CCG initiates a cancellation. The cancellation includes:
  * **Child Payment Id** : The cancelled payment
  * **Parent Transaction Id** : The split tender transaction
  * **Cancellation Reason** : `CCG_AUTOMATED_CANCEL`
  * **Cancellation Message** : Split Tender Transaction Failure
  * **Status** : Cancellation process status


Cancel Notifications
  * Merchant will receive `TRANSACTION_CANCELLED` event as part of attempt initiated
  * No separate `PAYMENT_CANCELLED` event is sent for cancellations initiated by CCG as part of rollback.


## Refunds and Reversal[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/rollback-strategies/#refunds-and-reversal "Direct link to Refunds and Reversal")
**Refunds and Reversals**
Refund and Reversal
#### Key Concepts[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/rollback-strategies/#key-concepts "Direct link to Key Concepts")
  * According to [Stripe documentation](https://docs.stripe.com/refunds?dashboard-or-api=dashboard#refund-and-reversal):
    * Refunds can be processed as **reversals** if issued shortly after the original charge.
    * **Impact:** Reversals typically incur lower network fees than standard refunds.


#### Payment Reversal[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/rollback-strategies/#payment-reversal "Direct link to Payment Reversal")
**What is Payment Reversal?**
As per **Stripe** , In the case of a reversal, customer won't see a refund credit on their statement – customer will just see the original authorisation drop off their statement entirely after a few days. There will be no payment, and no refund. It'll appear as if the whole transaction never happened. Their bank should be able to confirm this for them. Depending on customer's card issuer, the original charge should have disappeared from their pending charges by T+7 Days
#### Stripe Response on Reversal Windows[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/rollback-strategies/#stripe-response-on-reversal-windows "Direct link to Stripe Response on Reversal Windows")
  * **Question:** Is there a specific time window during which a refund is processed as a reversal?
  * **Stripe Support Response:** [Slack Thread](https://stripe.slack.com/archives/C08BR0Z696E/p1753436186780159) Stripe Response on Payment Reversal Window
    * The window is short—essentially until money has actually moved.
    * Reversals may be possible for up to a few hours after capture.
    * For uncaptured or expired authorizations, different rules apply.
    * These appear as refunds in your system but cost less due to reduced interchange fees.
    * The main difference is financial: some fees are not charged for reversals.
    * Merchants can determine which transactions were processed as reversals vs. refunds by examining transaction details.


#### Production Data Analysis - Reversal Processing Timeline[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/rollback-strategies/#production-data-analysis---reversal-processing-timeline "Direct link to Production Data Analysis - Reversal Processing Timeline")
**Case Study: Successful Reversal (64 seconds after capture)**
Event | Timestamp | Elapsed Time  
---|---|---  
**Payment Initiated** | `21/07/2025, 19:35:47` | T+0  
`payment_intent.created` | `21/07/2025, 19:35:48` | T+1s  
`payment_intent.amount_capturable_updated` | `21/07/2025, 19:35:49` | T+2s  
**Capture Initiated** | `22/07/2025, 19:04:22` | T+23h 28m 35s  
`payment_intent.succeeded` | `22/07/2025, 19:04:22` | T+23h 28m 35s  
**Refund Request Initiated** | `22/07/2025, 19:05:26` | T+23h 29m 39s  
`refund.created` | `22/07/2025, 19:05:27` | T+23h 29m 40s  
`charge.refunded` | `22/07/2025, 19:05:27` | T+23h 29m 40s  
`refund.updated` | `22/07/2025, 19:05:28` | T+23h 29m 41s  
**Key Metrics:**
  * Time between capture and refund: **64 seconds**
  * Refund processing time: **2 seconds**
  * Processed as: **Reversal** (confirmed via Stripe Dashboard)
  * Fee impact: **No Fee Charged**


## Best Practices & Merchant Guidance[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payments/split-tender/rollback-strategies/#best-practices--merchant-guidance "Direct link to Best Practices & Merchant Guidance")
  * Always use CCG APIs for split tender operations; avoid direct Stripe dashboard actions to prevent indeterminate states.
  * Monitor webhook events (`TRANSACTION_FAILED`, `PAYMENT_REFUNDED` , `PAYMENT_REVERSED`) for accurate transaction state tracking.
  * Implement logic to distinguish between merchant-initiated and CCG-initiated rollbacks using the `Refund Reason` or `Cancellation Reason` fields.
  * Communicate clearly with customers about the status of split tender payments, especially in the event of rollbacks or reversals.
  * For ACH payments, inform customers that refunds may take 1–3 business days to appear, while card reversals may result in the charge simply disappearing from their statement.
