## Special Use-Case[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payment-methods/payment-methods-types/card/3ds-authentication/#special-use-case "Direct link to Special Use-Case")
### 3DS-enabled card cannot be designated as a manufacturer card[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payment-methods/payment-methods-types/card/3ds-authentication/#3ds-enabled-card-cannot-be-designated-as-a-manufacturer-card "Direct link to 3DS-enabled card cannot be designated as a manufacturer card")
3DS emphasizes consumer-level identity verification (e.g., OTP, SMS verification, biometrics, authentication via issuer’s banking portal). Manufacturer Cards often represent corporate-level or supplier-level accounts, which typically have transaction management and approval workflows rather than individual cardholder authentication. These corporate/wholesale cards may explicitly avoid or bypass 3DS-style purposes and are typically restricted from regular commerce flows.
Because of these fundamental differences in purpose, security requirements, and regulatory considerations, a 3DS-enabled card cannot serve as a manufacturer card.
### Agent cannot add a card that requires 3DS challenge[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payment-methods/payment-methods-types/card/3ds-authentication/#agent-cannot-add-a-card-that-requires-3ds-challenge "Direct link to Agent cannot add a card that requires 3DS challenge")
**Reasoning:**
  * 3DS authentication is designed to be completed only by the cardholder for security and regulatory compliance.
  * Agents are not authorized to perform 3DS challenges on behalf of users, as this would violate security protocols and potentially expose sensitive information.


**Alternate Paths:**
  * Agents can send a secure, time-limited link via SMS or email, allowing the authenticated user to add the card or make payment and complete the 3DS challenge themselves. For more information, Refer [TEXT](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payment-methods/payment-method-channels/text-channel/) and [EMAIL](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payment-methods/payment-method-channels/email-channel/) channels.




# ACH Consent
## What is ACH Consent?[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payments/ach/consent/#what-is-ach-consent "Direct link to What is ACH Consent?")
ACH (Automated Clearing House) consent is a legal authorization provided by a customer that permits electronic debits from their bank account. This consent is required by NACHA (National Automated Clearing House Association) regulations before initiating any ACH transaction.
## When is Consent Required?[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payments/ach/consent/#when-is-consent-required "Direct link to When is Consent Required?")
Consent is **mandatory** for all ACH payments involving:
  * Saved payment methods (walletpaymentmethodId)
  * One-time payments without storing the payment method
  * IVR (Interactive Voice Response) payments
  * Any payment transaction using a Bank Account as the payment method


**Important** : Without valid consent, any payment transaction using a Bank Account payment method cannot and should not be processed.
## Consent Requirements by Payment Type[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payments/ach/consent/#consent-requirements-by-payment-type "Direct link to Consent Requirements by Payment Type")
Payment Type | Consent Required | Notes  
---|---|---  
Bank Account (ACH) | Yes | Full consent object required  
Credit/Debit Card | No | Consent not required for card payments  
Saved Bank Account | Yes | Consent must be associated with stored payment method  
IVR Bank Account | Yes | Specific TEL consent type required  
### Consent Object Structure[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payments/ach/consent/#consent-object-structure "Direct link to Consent Object Structure")
Show Consent Object JSON Schema
```
"consent": {  
  "merchantConsentId": "string",  
  "merchantConsentText": "string",  
  "collectionTimestamp": "string",  
  "collectionDetails": {  
    "type": "WEB",  
    "web": {  
      "ipAddress": "string",  
      "userAgent": "string"  
    },  
    "tel": {  
      "inboundPhoneNumber": {  
        "countryCode": "string",  
        "number": "string"  
      }  
    }  
  }  
}  

```

### Key Components:[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payments/ach/consent/#key-components "Direct link to Key Components:")
  * **merchantConsentText** : The actual text of the consent agreement shown to the customer.
    * Example: "I authorize [Company Name] to electronically debit my account for the amount due."
  * **merchantConsentId** : A unique identifier that references a consent agreement stored by the merchant.
    * **Note** : merchantConsentText and merchantConsentId are mutually exclusive. The API prioritizes merchantConsentId since the primary responsibility for consent collection rests with the merchant.
  * **collectionTimestamp** : The timestamp indicating precisely when consent was collected from the customer.
    * Must be in ISO-8601 format (e.g., "2025-07-21T14:30:00Z")
  * **collectionDetails** : Contains information about how the consent was collected
    * **type** : Specifies the consent collection method (WEB, TEL, PPD)
    * **web** : Web-specific collection details (required when type is WEB)
    * **tel** : Telephonic collection details (required when type is TEL)


### NACHA-Compliant Consent Collection Types[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payments/ach/consent/#nacha-compliant-consent-collection-types "Direct link to NACHA-Compliant Consent Collection Types")
NACHA regulations require specific consent collection methods for different ACH transaction types. The following types are specified in the `collectionDetails.type` field and are mutually exclusive:
#### 1. **WEB** - Online/Digital Consent[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payments/ach/consent/#1-web---onlinedigital-consent "Direct link to 1-web---onlinedigital-consent")
  * **Definition** : Consent collected electronically via website or mobile application
  * **Required Fields** :
    * `collectionDetails.web.ipAddress`: Customer's IP address at time of consent
    * `collectionDetails.web.userAgent`: Browser/device information at time of consent
  * **Use Cases** : Self-service payments, online bill pay, recurring payment setup
  * **Example** : Customer agrees to ACH terms by checking a box on the payment page


#### 2. **TEL** - Telephonic Consent[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payments/ach/consent/#2-tel---telephonic-consent "Direct link to 2-tel---telephonic-consent")
  * **Definition** : Verbal consent provided over the phone
  * **Required Fields** :
    * `collectionDetails.tel.inboundPhoneNumber`: Contains country code and phone number
  * **Use Cases** :
    * IVR (Interactive Voice Response) payments
    * Agent-assisted payments where customer is on the call
  * **Best Practice** : While not mandatory, recording the call reference ID is recommended


#### 3. **PPD** - Physical/Paper Consent[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payments/ach/consent/#3-ppd---physicalpaper-consent "Direct link to 3-ppd---physicalpaper-consent")
  * **Definition** : Consent collected via physical signed document
  * **Required Components** :
    * `collectionDetails.ppd`: Contains information about the paper document and processing agent
  * **Use Case** : Customer provides a signed paper authorization form


### Validation and Error Handling[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payments/ach/consent/#validation-and-error-handling "Direct link to Validation and Error Handling")
The payment processing system enforces strict consent validation:
  1. **Mandatory Requirement** : No ACH payment can proceed without a valid consent object
  2. **Validation Logic** :
     * Either `merchantConsentText` or `merchantConsentId` must be present (mutually exclusive)
     * `collectionTimestamp` must be included and must be a valid ISO-8601 timestamp
     * `collectionDetails.type` must be one of the supported values (WEB, TEL, PPD)
     * Type-specific fields must be present:
       * For WEB: `collectionDetails.web.ipAddress` and `collectionDetails.web.userAgent`
       * For TEL: `collectionDetails.tel.inboundPhoneNumber` with valid country code and number


### Security and Compliance Considerations[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payments/ach/consent/#security-and-compliance-considerations "Direct link to Security and Compliance Considerations")
  * Consent records should be retained according to NACHA retention requirements (generally 2 years)
  * Sensitive consent information should be properly encrypted in transit and at rest
  * Audit trails should track consent collection and usage throughout the payment lifecycle


## Sample Consent Objects[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payments/ach/consent/#sample-consent-objects "Direct link to Sample Consent Objects")

}

# Manufacturer Card
### What is Manufacturer card?[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payment-methods/payment-methods-types/card/manufacturer-card/#what-is-manufacturer-card "Direct link to What is Manufacturer card?")
A manufactured card, also known as a copay card or manufacturer-sponsored discount card, is issued by a pharmaceutical manufacturer to help reduce the out-of-pocket cost to support access to high-cost drugs.
They come in different forms but not limited:
  * **Single-use cards** : Valid for a one-time transaction.
  * **Multi-use or recurring cards:** Usable over multiple visits or prescription fills, often subject to predefined limits or expiration periods.


#### Example[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payment-methods/payment-methods-types/card/manufacturer-card/#example "Direct link to Example")
  * **Walgreens Credit Card** (issued by Synchrony Bank, usable only at Walgreens and Duane Reade stores, a chain of pharmacy and convenience stores owned by Walgreens)


## Business Rules[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payment-methods/payment-methods-types/card/manufacturer-card/#business-rules "Direct link to Business Rules")
  * **Category Configuration** : MF cards are recognized as a new category type `MANUFACTURER_CARD`. Refer to [payment method settings](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payment-methods/payment-methods-types/).
  * **Usage** : _Adding_ or _making payments_ with MF cards depends on this category configuration. However, _editing_ or _deleting_ MF cards is always allowed.
  * **Medication Link** : Every MF card must be linked to a medication.
  * **Default Restriction** : MF cards cannot be set as the [default](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payment-methods/default-payment-method/) payment method. [Learn more](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payment-methods/default-payment-method/#manufacturer-card-cannot-be-designated-as-default)
  * **3DS Exemption** : MF cards are exempt from [3DS authorisation](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payment-methods/payment-methods-types/card/3ds-authentication/). [Learn more](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payment-methods/payment-methods-types/card/3ds-authentication/#3ds-enabled-card-cannot-be-designated-as-a-manufacturer-card)
  * **Card Validation** : Validation is skipped for single-use MF cards during addition but not during payments.
    * When adding a card, Stripe performs [penny transactions](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/developers/getting-started/stripe/card-validation/#4-zero-value-authorization) for [card validations](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/developers/getting-started/stripe/card-validation/). However: Manufacturer cards _could_ be a single-use card, making penny validation irrelevant. This validation is intentionally skipped by CCG.
    * Some manufacturer card issuers prohibit $0 authorizations (e.g., single-use cards preloaded with $25 may only allow transactions equal to the preloaded amount).


important
  * CCG sets `verify_card_account` to `false` in the `set-up-intent-request` sent to Stripe.
  * Skipping card validation is a gated feature within Stripe.
  * This workaround remains active until Stripe implements a scalable, secure, long-term solution.


## Terminology[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payment-methods/payment-methods-types/card/manufacturer-card/#terminology "Direct link to Terminology")
### Legacy MF Card[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payment-methods/payment-methods-types/card/manufacturer-card/#legacy-mf-card "Direct link to Legacy MF Card")
a MF card not linked with a medication
info
'Legacy' doesn't just imply existing older cards in the system, as **new** legacy MF card can be added to the wallet by legacy client.
### Legacy Client[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payment-methods/payment-methods-types/card/manufacturer-card/#legacy-client "Direct link to Legacy Client")
Refers to an API consumer using the old contract format to manage MF card.
A client is considered legacy if "request payload" includes the `manufacturerCard` flag:
```
// sample req payload (add MF card flow / one time pay flow / pay and save flow)  
  
{  
    "paymentMethod": {  
        "paymentMethodDetails": {  
            "manufacturerCard": true // boolean   
        }  
}  

```

### New Client[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payment-methods/payment-methods-types/card/manufacturer-card/#new-client "Direct link to New Client")
Refers to an API consumer using the new contract format to manage MF card.
A client is considered new if "request payload" includes the `cardCategories` structure:
```
// sample req payload (add MF card flow / one time pay flow / pay and save flow)  
{  
    "paymentMethod": {  
        "paymentMethodDetails": {  
            "cardCategories": {  
                "type": "MANUFACTURER_CARD",  
                "medications": [  
                {  
                  "label": "Tremfya", // string  
                  "value": "5mg" // string  
                }  
              ]  
            }  
        }  
}  

```

### Manufacture Card Category Structure[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payment-methods/payment-methods-types/card/manufacturer-card/#manufacture-card-category-structure "Direct link to Manufacture Card Category Structure")
Field | Type | Valid values | Required | Constraints | Example  
---|---|---|---|---|---  
`type` | Enum | MANUFACTURE_CARD | Yes |  `"MANUFACTURER_CARD"` only | `"MANUFACTURER_CARD"`  
`label` | String |  | Yes | Max 100 chars | `"Pharmacy card"`  
`medications` | Object | [Medication](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payment-methods/payment-methods-types/card/manufacturer-card/#medication-structure) | No | List of `{label, value}` | See below  
### Medication Structure[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payment-methods/payment-methods-types/card/manufacturer-card/#medication-structure "Direct link to Medication Structure")
Field | Type | Required | Example  
---|---|---|---  
`label` | String | Yes | `"Tremfya"`  
`value` | String | Yes | `"10mg"`  
## Constraints[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payment-methods/payment-methods-types/card/manufacturer-card/#constraints "Direct link to Constraints")
  * `type` must be `"MANUFACTURER_CARD"` for manufacturer cards.
  * `label` is required and ≤ 100 characters.
  * `medications` is optional; if present, each must have both `label` and `value`.


## Validation Rules[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payment-methods/payment-methods-types/card/manufacturer-card/#validation-rules "Direct link to Validation Rules")
  * `type` must be a recognized enumeration value (e.g., `MANUFACTURER_CARD`).
  * If `type` is `MANUFACTURER_CARD`, `medications` **must** be present.
  * If `label` is present, it must be a non-empty string; if not provided, it defaults to the merchant-configured value.
  * Each entry in `medications[]` must include:
    * `label`: non-empty string and ≤ 100 characters.
    * `value`: non-empty string and ≤ 100 characters.


## Handling Mixed Payload Formats[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payment-methods/payment-methods-types/card/manufacturer-card/#handling-mixed-payload-formats "Direct link to Handling Mixed Payload Formats")
When a client sends a "request payload" containing both the old (manufacturerCard flag) and new (cardCategories structure) formats, the system will ignore the old format and process the payload using the new format. This ensures consistency with the latest business rules and avoids ambiguity.
```
// sample req payload: (add MF card flow / one time pay flow / pay and save flow)  
{    
    "paymentMethod": {    
        "paymentMethodDetails": {    
            "manufacturerCard": true, // boolean Old format (ignored)    
            "cardCategories": {    
                "type": "MANUFACTURER_CARD",    
                "medications": [    
                    {    
                        "label": "Tremfya", // string  
                        "value": "5mg" // string  
                    }    
                ]    
            }    
        }    
    }    
}    

```

### Use Case Handling Summary[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payment-methods/payment-methods-types/card/manufacturer-card/#use-case-handling-summary "Direct link to Use Case Handling Summary")
Scenario | Merchant Configured with MANUFACTURER_CARD | Merchant Not Configured with MANUFACTURER_CARD  
---|---|---  
`cardCategories` present in session request | Honor `cardCategories` and persist in DB. | Ignore `cardCategories`, save session without it  
cardCategories is not present in session request | Save session request as-is in DB. | Save session request as-is in DB.  
cardCategories is present in session request and no medications | Honor cardCategories and persist and persist without medications in DB. | Ignore cardCategories, save session without it.

# Card Payments
## Overview[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payments/card/#overview "Direct link to Overview")
Card payments are electronic transactions that use credit, debit, or prepaid cards to transfer funds from a cardholder's account to a merchant's account. The Convenient Checkout platform supports all major card types and provides a secure, compliant infrastructure for processing card payments across various channels and use cases.
Card Payment Networks
Our platform supports all major card networks:
  * **Visa** : The largest global payment network
  * **Mastercard** : Second-largest global payment network
  * **American Express** : Premium card network with higher processing fees but affluent customer base
  * **Discover** : Popular US-based payment network
  * **JCB** : Japanese Credit Bureau, popular in Asia
  * **Diners Club International** : Primarily used for travel and entertainment


## How Card Payments Work[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payments/card/#how-card-payments-work "Direct link to How Card Payments Work")
Card payments involve multiple parties and a series of steps to securely process transactions:
Card Payment Flow
  1. **Authorization** :
     * Customer presents card information
     * Merchant sends authorization request to payment processor
     * Issuing bank approves or declines
     * Approval response returned to merchant
  2. **Authentication** (for online transactions):
     * 3D Secure verification may be required
     * Customer authentication through issuing bank
  3. **Capture** :
     * Merchant submits transaction for settlement
     * Funds are transferred from issuing bank to acquiring bank
  4. **Settlement** :
     * Funds are deposited into merchant account
     * Typically takes 1-3 business days
  5. **Reconciliation** :
     * Transaction data matched with bank deposits


## Card Payment Types[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payments/card/#card-payment-types "Direct link to Card Payment Types")
Payment Type | Description | Use Cases  
---|---|---  
Credit Card | Revolving line of credit with deferred payment | Higher-value purchases, subscription billing  
Debit Card | Direct deduction from bank account | Everyday purchases, bill payments  
Prepaid Card | Pre-loaded with funds, no bank account needed | Gift cards, underbanked customers  
FSA/HSA Cards | Special purpose healthcare spending cards | Medical expenses, health services  
Virtual Cards | Card numbers generated for temporary use | One-time purchases, enhanced security  
## Card Processing Features[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payments/card/#card-processing-features "Direct link to Card Processing Features")
The Convenient Checkout platform provides comprehensive card processing capabilities:
### Payment Entry Methods[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payments/card/#payment-entry-methods "Direct link to Payment Entry Methods")
Card Entry Options
  * **Manual Entry** : Customer or agent manually enters card details
  * **Stored Cards** : Tokenized cards saved in the customer's wallet
  * **Card-Present** : In-person payments with physical cards (swipe, chip, tap)
  * **Digital Wallets** : Apple Pay, Google Pay, Samsung Pay integration
  * **IVR Payments** : Card details collected through interactive voice response
  * **CSR-Assisted** : Customer service representative collects card data


### Transaction Types[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payments/card/#transaction-types "Direct link to Transaction Types")
Supported Transaction Types
  * **Authorization** : Verifies card validity and available funds without capturing funds
  * **Capture** : Completes a previously authorized transaction
  * **Sale (Auth+Capture)** : Combined authorization and capture in a single step
  * **Refund** : Returns funds to the customer's card
  * **Void** : Cancels a transaction before settlement
  * **Verification** : Card validation without financial transaction


## Card Security Standards[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payments/card/#card-security-standards "Direct link to Card Security Standards")
Card payments require adherence to strict security standards:
### PCI DSS Compliance[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payments/card/#pci-dss-compliance "Direct link to PCI DSS Compliance")
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard
PCI DSS is a set of security standards designed to ensure all companies that accept, process, store, or transmit credit card information maintain a secure environment. Key requirements include:
  1. **Network Security** : Install and maintain a firewall configuration
  2. **Data Protection** : Encrypt transmission of cardholder data
  3. **Vulnerability Management** : Regular system updates and security patches
  4. **Access Control** : Restrict access to cardholder data
  5. **Network Monitoring** : Regular testing of security systems
  6. **Security Policy** : Maintain a policy addressing information security


The Convenient Checkout platform is fully PCI DSS compliant, reducing merchant compliance burden.
### Tokenization[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payments/card/#tokenization "Direct link to Tokenization")
Card Tokenization Process
Tokenization replaces sensitive card data with a unique identifier (token) that has no exploitable value. Benefits include:
  * **Reduced Risk** : Tokens cannot be used to conduct fraudulent transactions
  * **Simplified Compliance** : Reduces PCI DSS scope and requirements
  * **Enhanced Customer Experience** : Enables card storage for future use without security risks


Our platform handles tokenization automatically, securely storing customer payment methods for future use.
### 3D Secure (3DS)[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payments/card/#3d-secure-3ds "Direct link to 3D Secure \(3DS\)")
Enhanced Authentication
3D Secure (including versions 1.0, 2.0, and 2.1) provides an additional security layer for online card transactions:
  * **Dynamic Authentication** : Risk-based approach that only challenges suspicious transactions
  * **Liability Shift** : Shifts fraud liability from merchant to issuing bank
  * **Reduced Cart Abandonment** : Newer versions (2.0+) offer frictionless flows for low-risk transactions


Our implementation supports the latest 3DS protocols while maintaining a smooth customer experience.
## Card Processing Implementation[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payments/card/#card-processing-implementation "Direct link to Card Processing Implementation")
### Integration Options[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payments/card/#integration-options "Direct link to Integration Options")
Integration Type | Description | Use Cases  
---|---|---  
API Direct | Full control through RESTful API endpoints | Custom checkout experiences  
Hosted Payment Page | Secure, pre-built payment collection | Quick implementation, reduced PCI scope  
iFrame | Embedded payment form within merchant page | Balance between customization and security  
## Advanced Features[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payments/card/#advanced-features "Direct link to Advanced Features")
### Recurring Payments[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payments/card/#recurring-payments "Direct link to Recurring Payments")
Subscription and Recurring Billing
Convenient Checkout supports various recurring payment models:
  * **Fixed Recurring** : Same amount charged at regular intervals
  * **Variable Recurring** : Amount varies based on usage or billing
  * **Installment Plans** : Fixed number of payments over time
  * **Account Updater** : Automatically updates expired card information
  * **Retry Logic** : Configurable retry attempts for failed recurring payments


Recurring payments require explicit customer authorization and proper disclosure of terms.
### Multi-Currency Processing[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payments/card/#multi-currency-processing "Direct link to Multi-Currency Processing")
International Payment Support
Process transactions in multiple currencies:
  * **Dynamic Currency Conversion** : Allow customers to pay in their local currency
  * **Multi-Currency Settlement** : Receive funds in preferred currency
  * **Exchange Rate Management** : Transparent exchange rate handling
  * **Regional Payment Methods** : Support for region-specific card types


### Card Verification and AVS[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payments/card/#card-verification-and-avs "Direct link to Card Verification and AVS")
Fraud Prevention Measures
  * **Address Verification System (AVS)** : Compares billing address with issuing bank's records
  * **Card Verification Value (CVV/CVC)** : Validates the security code on the card
  * **Postal Code Verification** : Verifies the billing zip/postal code
  * **Velocity Checks** : Monitors transaction frequency for suspicious patterns
  * **Machine Learning Fraud Detection** : Advanced risk scoring algorithms


## Error Handling and Decline Management[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payments/card/#error-handling-and-decline-management "Direct link to Error Handling and Decline Management")
### Common Decline Codes[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payments/card/#common-decline-codes "Direct link to Common Decline Codes")
Understanding Decline Reasons
Decline Code | Description | Recommended Action  
---|---|---  
Insufficient Funds | Card lacks available funds | Suggest alternative payment method  
Card Expired | Card expiration date has passed | Request updated card information  
Invalid Card Number | Card number is incorrect | Verify card details  
Do Not Honor | Generic decline from issuing bank | Try alternative payment method  
AVS Mismatch | Address verification failed | Verify billing address  
CVV Mismatch | Security code verification failed | Verify security code  
Transaction Not Allowed | Card not enabled for this transaction type | Suggest alternative payment method  
Suspected Fraud | Transaction flagged as potentially fraudulent | Contact customer to verify transaction  
### Decline Recovery Strategies[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payments/card/#decline-recovery-strategies "Direct link to Decline Recovery Strategies")
Optimizing Approval Rates
  * **Retry Logic** : Intelligent retry strategy for soft declines
  * **Account Updater** : Automatically refresh expired card details
  * **Decline Recycling** : Process declined transactions at optimal times
  * **Smart Routing** : Route transactions through different processors based on card type
  * **Alternative Payment Suggestions** : Offer different payment methods after decline

Healthcare-Specific Requirements
Card payments in healthcare have unique requirements:
  * **FSA/HSA Card Processing** : Support for qualified medical expenses
  * **HIPAA Compliance** : Secure handling of protected health information
  * **Eligibility Verification** : Integration with insurance eligibility APIs

# Enterprise Wallet
## Overview[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/wallet/enterprise-wallet/#overview "Direct link to Overview")
The **Enterprise Wallet** in CCG enables merchants to manage enterprise-level customer accounts efficiently. It ensures each enterprise customer is uniquely identified and securely linked to their payment information.
## Customer Creation Workflow[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/wallet/enterprise-wallet/#customer-creation-workflow "Direct link to Customer Creation Workflow")
When a merchant initiates a session, the following steps are performed to create or update a CCG customer:
  1. **Retrieve Customer Information**
     * Call EIMP to obtain customer details. This integration is managed by CCG and is transparent to merchants.
     * Attempt to match the customer to an existing Enterprise ID (EID).
  2. **Evaluate EIMP Record**
     * **No EIMP record found:**
       * Create a local customer in CCG.
     * **EIMP record found:**
       * **Customer exists in CCG:**
         * Update the customer information in CCG.
         * ⚠️ **Limitation:** The Customer table enforces a unique index on enterprise ID. If a customer with the same EID exists but is inactive, an exception will occur.
       * **Customer does not exist in CCG:**
         * Create a new customer and an enterprise wallet in CCG.


* * *

* * *
## Key Considerations[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/wallet/enterprise-wallet/#key-considerations "Direct link to Key Considerations")
  * The unique index on enterprise ID ensures that each enterprise customer is created only once in CCG.
  * Handle inactive customers carefully to avoid exceptions during customer creation or updates.
  * Always verify the status of the customer before attempting to create or update records.
  * EIMP integration is handled by CCG; merchants do not need to interact with EIMP directly.


note
Proper error handling and validation are essential to maintain data integrity and prevent duplicate enterprise customers. If EIMP is unavailable or returns errors, ensure fallback logic is in place to handle local customer creation gracefully.


# Payment Modes
CCG allows following payment modes
  * Pay with Wallet
  * One Time Pay
  * Pay and Store


## Pay with Wallet[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payments/payment-modes/#pay-with-wallet "Direct link to Pay with Wallet")
Pay with Wallet refers to making a payment using a digital wallet or mobile wallet application. A digital wallet is a virtual wallet that allows users to securely store payment information, such as credit/debit card details, bank account information, and other payment methods, on a mobile device or online platform.
## One Time Pay[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payments/payment-modes/#one-time-pay "Direct link to One Time Pay")
One-time payment refers to a single payment made by the payer to resolve a debt, acquire goods or services, or meet a financial obligation. In contrast to recurring payments or subscriptions, a one-time payment does not entail continuous charges or automatic withdrawals from the payer's account. This payment method enables the payer to make a solitary payment for a particular purpose without the requirement for recurring payments or sustained financial obligations
## Pay and Save[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payments/payment-modes/#pay-and-save "Direct link to Pay and Save")
Pay and Save is crucial for managing subscriptions, installment payments, and recurring expenses, as it involves setting up automatic deductions from the individual's account at regular intervals, such as monthly or annually. By incorporating a savings component, Pay and Save enables individuals to streamline financial management, automate the savings process, and make significant strides towards securing a stable financial future.
## IVR[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payments/payment-modes/#ivr "Direct link to IVR")
IVR stands for Interactive Voice Response. It is a technology that allows automated interactions with callers through voice and touch-tone inputs. IVR systems can provide information, route calls, and enable self-service options without the need for human intervention
IVR technology is commonly used in payment gateways for various purposes, including:
  * **Payment Processing** : IVR systems can securely process payments over the phone by allowing customers to enter their payment information using their touch-tone keypad.
  * **Payment Verification** : IVR can be used to verify payment details, such as confirming payment amounts, transaction IDs, or account numbers.
  * **Payment Reminders** : IVR can send automated payment reminders to customers, prompting them to make payments or update their payment information.
  * **Customer Service** : IVR systems can handle customer inquiries related to payments, account balances, transaction history, and more, providing a self-service option for customers.
  * **Payment Authentication** : IVR can be used for two-factor authentication or verification purposes to ensure secure payment transactions.




# Refunds
## What is a Refund?[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payments/refunds/#what-is-a-refund "Direct link to What is a Refund?")
A refund is the return of funds to a customer after they have made a payment for a product or service. Refunds are typically issued when a customer is dissatisfied with a product or service, when an error occurs in the transaction, or when a business policy allows for returns.
## Types of Refunds[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payments/refunds/#types-of-refunds "Direct link to Types of Refunds")
### Linked Refund[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payments/refunds/#linked-refund "Direct link to Linked Refund")
Linked refunds are processed against an existing completed payment transaction. A successfully completed transaction is required before a linked refund can be issued.
### Unlinked Refund[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payments/refunds/#unlinked-refund "Direct link to Unlinked Refund")
An unlinked refund (also known as a credit or cashback) is issued directly to the payment method ID without requiring a prior transaction. This allows for issuing credits to customers without an original transaction reference.
## Business Rules[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payments/refunds/#business-rules "Direct link to Business Rules")
### Pre-Conditions for All Refunds[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payments/refunds/#pre-conditions-for-all-refunds "Direct link to Pre-Conditions for All Refunds")
  * A valid refund reason must be provided. Acceptable reasons are:
    * `REQUESTED_BY_CUSTOMER`
    * `DUPLICATE`
    * `FRAUDULENT`
  * A unique `MerchantTransactionId` is required to issue any refund


### Linked Refund Requirements[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payments/refunds/#linked-refund-requirements "Direct link to Linked Refund Requirements")
  * The original payment transaction must have a status of `COMPLETED`
  * Refund amount must be less than or equal to the original payment amount
  * If no amount is specified, the full original payment amount will be refunded
  * The following refund types are supported:
    * **Partial Refunds** : Only a portion of the transaction amount is refunded
    * **Full Refunds** : The entire transaction amount is refunded
    * **Multiple Refunds** : Multiple partial refunds can be processed for a single transaction, but the cumulative refund amount cannot exceed the total transaction amount


### Unlinked Refund Requirements[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payments/refunds/#unlinked-refund-requirements "Direct link to Unlinked Refund Requirements")
  * Valid customer and payment method is required
  * Specific refund amount must be provided
  * Bank account payment method are not supported for unlinked refunds
  * Partial & Full Refunds are not applicable for Unlinked Refunds


## Refund Statuses[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payments/refunds/#refund-statuses "Direct link to Refund Statuses")
Refunds may transition through the following statuses:
  * `PENDING`: The refund request has been received and is being processed
  * `COMPLETED`: The refund has been successfully processed and funds are being returned to the customer
  * `FAILED`: The refund could not be processed due to an error or validation failure


## Business Use Case Flows[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/payments/refunds/#business-use-case-flows "Direct link to Business Use Case Flows")

A **Local Wallet** in CCG is created for customers who do not have an associated record in the Enterprise Identity Management Platform (EIMP). This wallet allows merchants to securely store and manage payment information for users not linked to an enterprise account.
## Local Customer Creation Workflow[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/wallet/local-wallet/#local-customer-creation-workflow "Direct link to Local Customer Creation Workflow")
When a merchant initiates a session and no EIMP record is found for the customer, CCG creates a local customer and a local wallet. This ensures that all customers, regardless of enterprise affiliation, can store and use payment methods securely.

# Wallet Upgrade
## Local To Enterprise wallet upgrade[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/wallet/wallet-upgrade/#local-to-enterprise-wallet-upgrade "Direct link to Local To Enterprise wallet upgrade")
## Overview[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/wallet/wallet-upgrade/#overview "Direct link to Overview")
When a consumer has a local wallet and is identified as having an enterprise identity, the local wallet is upgraded to an enterprise wallet. The goal is for each consumer to have a single enterprise wallet containing all unique payment methods, with no duplicates. This process improves user experience and reduces maintenance by consolidating payment methods.
#### Scenario: Multi-Criteria Search for Wallet Upgrade[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/wallet/wallet-upgrade/#scenario-multi-criteria-search-for-wallet-upgrade "Direct link to Scenario: Multi-Criteria Search for Wallet Upgrade")
##### Merchant Enterprise Settings Example[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/wallet/wallet-upgrade/#merchant-enterprise-settings-example "Direct link to Merchant Enterprise Settings Example")
  * **Search Criteria 1:** `SubscriptionId` and `DependentCode`
  * **Search Criteria 2:** `ExchangeID`


###### Step-by-Step Logic (with Example)[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/wallet/wallet-upgrade/#step-by-step-logic-with-example "Direct link to Step-by-Step Logic \(with Example\)")
  1. **Search on IMDM with Search Criteria 1 (`SubscriptionId` and `DependentCode`):**
     * Assume we find a golden record in IMDM with `SubscriptionId`, `DependentCode`, and `ExchangeID`.
  2. **Check CCG Database for Wallet (`SubscriptionId` and `DependentCode`):**
     * If a wallet exists for this combination, the search is complete (customer found).
     * If not, proceed to the next step.
  3. **Check Additional Search Criteria (from Merchant Configuration):**
     * For each search criteria defined (e.g., `ExchangeID`), check if the golden record contains the value.
     * If so, check if a local wallet exists in CCG for that value under the merchant.
     * If a wallet is found, upgrade it to an enterprise wallet.
     * Repeat for all search criteria until a wallet is found or all options are exhausted.
  4. **If No Wallet Found:**
     * Create a new customer and associate with `SubscriptionId` and `DependentCode`.


#### Example[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/wallet/wallet-upgrade/#example "Direct link to Example")
  * Merchant defines two search criteria: (1) `SubscriptionId` + `DependentCode`, (2) `ExchangeID`.
  * Golden record contains all three values.
  * CCG checks for a wallet with `SubscriptionId` + `DependentCode`. If not found, checks for a wallet with `ExchangeID`. If found, upgrades that wallet. If none found, creates a new wallet.


## Upgrade Process: Merge & De-duplicate[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/wallet/wallet-upgrade/#upgrade-process-merge--de-duplicate "Direct link to Upgrade Process: Merge & De-duplicate")
* * *

* * *
#### When a local wallet is upgraded to an enterprise wallet:[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/business/core-capabilities/wallet/wallet-upgrade/#when-a-local-wallet-is-upgraded-to-an-enterprise-wallet "Direct link to When a local wallet is upgraded to an enterprise wallet:")
  * If the consumer already has an enterprise wallet, payment methods from the local wallet are merged into the enterprise wallet.
  * Duplicate payment methods are de-duplicated so each unique payment method exists only once.
  * The local wallet is emptied after the merge.
  * Merchants are notified about any additions, replacements, or removals of payment methods via webhooks.
  * After merging, the local wallet will be empty.

























# Introduction
## What is report?[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/reports/introduction/#what-is-report "Direct link to What is report?")
Reports in a payment gateway refer to the detailed information and data related to transactions processed through the gateway. These reports provide valuable insights into the financial activity of an organization, including details such as successful and failed transactions, transaction amounts, payment statuses, customer information, and more.
Payment gateway reports typically include various types of reports such as transaction reports, settlement reports, reconciliation reports, chargeback reports, and refund reports. These reports help businesses track and monitor their financial transactions, analyze payment trends, reconcile accounts, and make informed decisions based on the data provided.
Overall, reports in a payment gateway play a crucial role in helping businesses manage their payment processing operations efficiently and effectively.
## What are all the reports offered by CCG?[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/reports/introduction/#what-are-all-the-reports-offered-by-ccg "Direct link to What are all the reports offered by CCG?")
Convenient Checkout Gateway (CCG) will provide payout reports via Electronic Communication Gateway(ECG).  
A Payout report is a reconciliation report to help match the payouts received in the Merchants bank account with the payments and other transactions that they relate to. There are two types of payout reports:
  * [Individual Payout](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/developers/add-on-services/reports/merchant-payout/) for Merchants and Finance team
  * [Combined Payout](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/developers/add-on-services/reports/combined-report/) for Treasury Team
  * [Transaction-Level Fee report](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/developers/add-on-services/reports/transaction-level-fee-report/) for Merchants




# Webhook
## Understanding Webhooks[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/#understanding-webhooks "Direct link to Understanding Webhooks")
A webhook is a way for an app or service to provide other apps or services with real-time information. It allows one application to notify another application or service about specific events or updates by sending a HTTP POST request to a specified URL when a certain event occurs. Webhooks are commonly used in various scenarios such as triggering actions in response to specific events, integrating different systems, and automating processes. They are commonly used in APIs and web services to facilitate communication and data exchange between different applications.
## Advantages of Webhooks[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/#advantages-of-webhooks "Direct link to Advantages of Webhooks")
The implementation of webhooks empowers CCG to promptly notify your system about transaction-related events. Upon the incidence of a specific event, such as a successful payment or a refund, your system receives instantaneous updates and can initiate appropriate responses tailored to the event, such as updating order statuses or dispatching confirmation emails to customers. Webhooks are instrumental in automating processes and ensuring that systems remain synchronized with the payment gateway.
## Webhook workflow[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/#webhook-workflow "Direct link to Webhook workflow")
The webhook workflow entails three primary participants: the provider, the consumer, and the event:
  * **Provider** : This is the application responsible for initiating an event and dispatching a notification to the consumer.
  * **Consumer** : Refers to the application that subscribes to and collects the notifications transmitted by the provider.
  * **Event** : Denotes an incident or particular action occurring within the provider application that serves as the trigger for the webhook.


_**CCG leverages webhooks to transmit notifications for payment transactions, refunds, dispute resolutions, and wallet management actions, encompassing the addition, modification, and removal of payment methods.**_


# Payment Methods
This document describes the webhook events related to payment methods and their structures.
Quick Reference
  * [Supported Events](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/payment-methods/#supported-events) - List of all payment method webhook events
  * [Event Structure](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/payment-methods/#event-structure) - Core structure of webhook event payloads
  * [Payload Structure](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/payment-methods/#payload-structure) - Details of the payload object
  * [Data Structures](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/payment-methods/#data-structures) - Reference for all data structures
  * [Sample Events](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/payment-methods/#sample-events) - Example JSON payloads for different payment method events


## Supported Events[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/payment-methods/#supported-events "Direct link to Supported Events")
**Supported Events**
Event Type | Description  
---|---  
PAYMENT_METHOD_CREATED | Emitted when a payment method is created.  
PAYMENT_METHOD_UPDATED | Emitted when a payment method is updated.  
PAYMENT_METHOD_DELETED | Emitted when a payment method is deleted.  
PAYMENT_METHOD_REPLACED | Emitted when a payment method is replaced. [More details](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payment-methods/replaced-payment-method/)  
## Event Structure[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/payment-methods/#event-structure "Direct link to Event Structure")
**Event Structure**
Field | Type | Valid values | Description  
---|---|---|---  
name | Enum | PAYMENT_METHOD_CREATED, PAYMENT_METHOD_UPDATED, PAYMENT_METHOD_DELETED, PAYMENT_METHOD_REPLACED | Event name  
source | string | Max length 50 | Indicates the X-source header value received in API request  
payload | [Payload](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/payment-methods/#payload-structure) |  | Event Payload  
## Payload Structure[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/payment-methods/#payload-structure "Direct link to Payload Structure")
**Payload Structure**
Field | Type | Valid values | Description  
---|---|---|---  
paymentMethod | [PaymentMethod](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/payment-methods/#paymentmethod-structure) |  | Payment method Description  
customer | [Customer](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/payment-methods/#customer-structure) |  | Customer Description  
agent | [Agent](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/payment-methods/#agent-structure) |  | Agent Description  
deletedPaymentMethodId | UUID | Valid UUID | Deleted PaymentMethod Id, in PAYMENT_METHOD_REPLACED event  
## Data Structures[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/payment-methods/#data-structures "Direct link to Data Structures")
### Customer Structure[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/payment-methods/#customer-structure "Direct link to Customer Structure")
**Customer Structure**
Field | Type | Valid values | Description  
---|---|---|---  
enterpriseIdentifier | string | Max length | Enterprise Identifier  
hsid | uuid | valid uuid4 | Healthsafe Identifier  
metadata | Object |  | Client provided additional metadata  
firstName | String |  | first name  
lastName | String |  | last name  
dateOfBirth | Date (YYYY-MM-DD) |  | Date of Birth, e.g. 1975-11-14  
email | String |  | email address  
ssnLastFour | Digits (4) |  | SSN last four digits, e.g 1234  
phoneNumber | Object |  | Contains both the phone number and the country code  
└─ number | Digits (10-20) |  | Phone number, e.g. 9876543210  
└─ countryCode | Digits (1-3) |  | Country code, e.g. 91  
zip5 | Digits (5) |  | ZIP Code, e.g. 10001  
### Agent Structure[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/payment-methods/#agent-structure "Direct link to Agent Structure")
**Agent Structure**
Field | Type | Valid values | Description  
---|---|---|---  
firstName | string | Max length 50 | First name of Agent  
lastName | string | Max length 50 | Last name of Agent  
userId | string | Max length 50 | MSId of Agent  
isAccessVerified | boolean | true/false | Is access verified by merchant  
### PaymentMethod Structure[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/payment-methods/#paymentmethod-structure "Direct link to PaymentMethod Structure")
**PaymentMethod Structure**
Field | Type | Valid values | Description  
---|---|---|---  
id | uuid | valid uuid4 | Payment method Id  
~~card~~ | [Card](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/payment-methods/#card-structure) |  | Card Description when payment Method is of type CARD.   
**Deprecated in favour of paymentMethodDetails**  
nickname | string | Max length 50 | Payment method nickname  
default | boolean | true/false | determines if the payment method is default for the customer  
paymentMethodType | string | Max length 50 | Payment method type can be CARD or BANK_ACCOUNT  
paymentMethodDetails |  [Card](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/payment-methods/#card-structure) or [ACH](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/payment-methods/#ach-structure) |  | One of Card or ACH  
### Card Structure[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/payment-methods/#card-structure "Direct link to Card Structure")
**Card Structure**
Field | Type | Valid values | Description  
---|---|---|---  
nameOnCard | string | Max length 50 | Name of the customer  
cardBrand | string | VISA, AMEX, DINERS, DISCOVER, JCB, MASTERCARD, UNIONPAY, UNKNOWN | Card brand  
expiryMonth | long | 01-12 | Month of expiration  
expiryYear | long | Max length 4 | Year of expiration  
last4 | string | Max length 4 | Last four digits of the card  
zipCode | string | Max length 5 | 5 digit zipcode  
status | string | ACTIVE/EXPIRED | Status of the card  
manufacturerCard | boolean | true/false | Determines if the card is manufacturer card or not. Only Agents can flag certain cards as manufacturer cards. Cards flagged as manufacturer cards cannot be default card.  
### ACH Structure[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/payment-methods/#ach-structure "Direct link to ACH Structure")
**ACH Structure**
Field | Type | Valid values | Description  
---|---|---|---  
type | string | BANK_ACCOUNT | Type of the PaymentMethod  
accountHolderType | string | individual or company | Account holder type  
accountType | string | checking or savings | Account Type  
bankName | string |  | Bank Name  
last4 | string |  | Last 4 digits of bank account number  
routingNumber | string |  | Routing number of bank  
nameOnAccount | string |  | Name on Account  
status | enum | ACTIVE and INVALIDATED | Bank Account Status

# Disputes
## Overview[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/disputes/#overview "Direct link to Overview")
Disputes (also known as chargebacks) occur when a customer questions a charge with their card issuer or bank, resulting in a formal dispute process. Using webhooks, merchant applications can receive real-time updates on dispute status changes and related events, allowing them to respond promptly and efficiently manage the dispute resolution process.
## Supported Events[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/disputes/#supported-events "Direct link to Supported Events")
Event Type | Description | Applicable payment method types  
---|---|---  
DISPUTE_WON | Emitted when dispute is won and funds are reinstated. | CARD, BANK_ACCOUNT  
DISPUTE_LOST | Emitted when dispute is lost. | CARD, BANK_ACCOUNT  
DISPUTE_INITIATED | Emitted when a dispute is created and funds are withdrawn. | CARD, BANK_ACCOUNT  
### Event Structure[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/disputes/#event-structure "Direct link to Event Structure")
Field | Type | Valid values | Description  
---|---|---|---  
name | Enum | DISPUTE_WON, DISPUTE_LOST, DISPUTE_INITIATED | Event name  
payload | [Payload](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/disputes/#payload-structure) |  | Event Payload  
### Payload Structure[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/disputes/#payload-structure "Direct link to Payload Structure")
The payload contains comprehensive information about the dispute, including:
Field | Type | Description  
---|---|---  
amount | Number | The disputed amount  
eventType | String | Type of dispute event (DISPUTE_INITIATED, DISPUTE_WON, DISPUTE_LOST)  
merchantTransactionId | String | Unique identifier for the merchant's transaction  
merchantId | String | Unique identifier for the merchant  
evidence | Object | Collection of evidence related to the dispute  
reason | String | The reason for the dispute (e.g., "FRAUDULENT")  
status | String | Current status of the dispute (e.g., "NEEDS_RESPONSE")  
paymentType | String | Type of payment method involved in the dispute  
balanceTransactions | Array | List of balance transaction records related to the dispute  
#### Evidence Object[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/disputes/#evidence-object "Direct link to Evidence Object")
The evidence object contains fields that can be submitted to support your case in a dispute. Different dispute reasons may require different types of evidence:
  * `billing_address`: Customer's billing address
  * `customer_name`: Name of the customer
  * `receipt`: Receipt or proof of purchase
  * `service_documentation`: Documentation of services provided
  * `shipping_documentation`: Shipping confirmations or documentation
  * And many other fields relevant to the specific dispute case


#### Balance Transaction Object[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/disputes/#balance-transaction-object "Direct link to Balance Transaction Object")
Each balance transaction contains details about financial impact:
  * `amount`: Transaction amount
  * `currency`: Currency code
  * `fee`: Associated fees
  * `description`: Description of the transaction
  * `status`: Status of the transaction
  * And other relevant financial details


### Payload Structure Sample[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/disputes/#payload-structure-sample "Direct link to Payload Structure Sample")

# Reporting data
## Types of Data[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/reports/report-metadata/#types-of-data "Direct link to Types of Data")
Depending on the audience of Payout report, it will be composed of the combination of four categories of data:
### CCG specific metadata[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/reports/report-metadata/#ccg-specific-metadata "Direct link to CCG specific metadata")
CCG will always include the following metadata in payments and other transactions.
#### CCG Payment metadata[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/reports/report-metadata/#ccg-payment-metadata "Direct link to CCG Payment metadata")
Field Name | Description | Sample value  
---|---|---  
checkoutId | CCG unique checkout identifier | 434189e3-e63v-47ef-a8fc-0d9a6d22f6c8  
merchantGroupId | CCG merchant Group Identifier composed of different Merchants belonging to a same group | 98da3d38-ff4j-44ee-be00-c47a94ed01a4  
merchantId | CCG unique merchant identifier | d4d9760a-9cea-45h8-a25d-e6a3612e479a  
merchantName | CCG merchant name | someNewMerchant-merchant-stage  
merchantTransactionId | Merchant payment transaction identifier | cef9923e-9fe0-4679-82hf-7151fe311cbb  
referenceId | CCG unique reference identifier | e1837bc7-f5b3-4f52-bfrg-77e8d1cc95a0  
ccg_processor | CCG processor | STRIPE  
ccg_paymentmethodlast4 | CCG payment method last 4 | 1234  
ccg_nameoncard | CCG name that was entered for the card | Shahrukh Khan  
ccg_paymentmethodnickname | CCG nickname for customers payment method | personal WF Master  
ccg_paymentMethodId | CCG Payment method id | 534179e3-redv-47ef-a7fc-0d9a5d22f6c7  
merchantTransactionId | merchant unique Transaction identifier | cef9923e-9fe0-4679-82hf-7151fe311cbb  
#### CCG Refund metadata[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/reports/report-metadata/#ccg-refund-metadata "Direct link to CCG Refund metadata")
Field Name | Description | Sample value  
---|---|---  
ccg_refundId | CCG unique refund identifier | bf75eb27-7b1f-4171-b27f-099a284f5540  
merchantTransactionId | Merchant refund transaction identifier | cef9923e-9fe0-4679-82hf-7151fe312cbe  
Merchant chosen data that may be beneficial to tie back to Merchant records for reconciling, reporting etc.
### Merchant specific metadata[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/reports/report-metadata/#merchant-specific-metadata "Direct link to Merchant specific metadata")
#### Merchant Payment metadata[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/reports/report-metadata/#merchant-payment-metadata "Direct link to Merchant Payment metadata")
Merchant chosen data that may be beneficial to tie back to Merchant records for reconciling, reporting etc. Merchant can have payment or refund specific metadata.Some examples of Payment meta data:
#### Merchant Payment metadata | Field Name | Description | Sample value |[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/reports/report-metadata/#merchant-payment-metadata--field-name-----description-------------------------------------------sample-value------------------------- "Direct link to Merchant Payment metadata | Field Name    | Description                                          | Sample value                         |")
Some examples of Payment meta data:
Field Name | Description | Sample value  
---|---|---  
ItemCode | Merchants unique code for an Item | 3456-4876  
orderId | Merchant unique orderId | 98da3d38-ff4j-44ee-be00-c47a94ed01a4  
siteName | Merchant site where payment is initiated from | [www.somesitename.com](http://www.somesitename.com)  
claimId | Merchant unique claim identifier payment is made for | ABCDE-12345  
InvoiceNumber | Merchant unique Invoice number payment is made for | 34987  
#### Merchant Refund Metadata | Field Name | Description | Sample value |[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/reports/report-metadata/#merchant-refund-metadata--field-name--description--------------------------sample-value- "Direct link to Merchant Refund Metadata | Field Name | Description                         | Sample value |")
Some examples of Refund meta data:
| Field Name | Description | Sample value | | :--------- | :---------------------------------- | :----------- |### Transaction data | Refund_ID | Merchants refund Identifier | 3456-4876 | | Claim_ID | Claim ID the refund will go towards | ABCDF-12346 | | Field Name | Description | Sample value |
### Transaction data[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/reports/report-metadata/#transaction-data "Direct link to Transaction data")
Field Name | Description | Sample value  
---|---|---  
customer_name | Name of the customer, if any, associated with the transaction | John Smith  
customer_email | Email address of the customer, if any, associated with the transaction | testcustomer@gmail.com  
reporting_category | Categorization of transaction | charge  
charge_created_utc | Creation time of the original charge associated with this balance transaction. Available for charges, refunds and disputes. For charges that were separately authorized and captured, this is the authorization time. Dates in UTC. | 2023-08-16 10:14:30  
payment_method_type | The type of payment method used in the related payment. | card  
dispute_reason | Reason given by cardholder for dispute | fraudulent  
shipping_address_postal_code | Postal code of the shipping address associated with this charge, if any | 123456  
currency | Three-letter ISO code for the currency in which the gross, fee and net amounts are defined | usd  
created_utc | Time at which the balance transaction was created. Dates in UTC. | 2023-08-16 10:15:32  
available_on_utc | The date the balance transaction’s net funds will become available in the Stripe balance. Dates in UTC. | 2023-08-23 12:00:00  
gross | Gross amount of the transaction. Expressed in major units of the currency | 35.33  
net | Net amount of the transaction. Expressed in major units of the currency | 34.01  
fee | Fees paid for this transaction Expressed in major units of the currency | 1.32  
description | Payment description that will be useful to a Merchant to identify the payment | UI widget payment  
card_brand | CCG merchant name, set up when the merchant is onboarded | Possible values:AMEX, CARTES_BANCAIRES, DINERS, DISCOVER, INTERAC, JCB, MASTERCARD, UNIONPAY, VISA, UNKNOWN  
card_funding | CCG merchant name, set up when the merchant is onboarded | Possible values:CREDIT, DEBIT, PREPAID, UNKNOWN  
processor | Who processed the transaction | STRIPE  
payment_method_last4 | The last four of the payment method account/card number | 1234

# Merchant Settings
## Merchant Settings Configuration[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/configuration/merchant-settings/#merchant-settings-configuration "Direct link to Merchant Settings Configuration")
Configure the following settings as part of onboarding:
### Payment Methods[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/configuration/merchant-settings/#payment-methods "Direct link to Payment Methods")
  * **Types Supported:** `Card`, `Bank Account`
  * **Special Card Types:** `Manufacturer Card`
  * **Channels:** `Email`, `Text`, `Webform`, `GooglePay`, `ApplePay`, `TelePhonic Entry`


### Additional Features[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/configuration/merchant-settings/#additional-features "Direct link to Additional Features")
  * [**WS2Check**](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payment-methods/payment-method-channels/on-screen-entry/ws2/): Enable for on-screen entry validation.
  * [**Telephonic Entry**](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/business/core-capabilities/payment-methods/payment-method-channels/telephonic-entry/): Set `telephonicEntryEnabled` as needed.


### Customer Find Logic[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/configuration/merchant-settings/#customer-find-logic "Direct link to Customer Find Logic")
  * [Merchant Customer Identifier](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/developers/convenient-checkout-api/customers/customer-creation/#overview)
  * Customer are identified through [Enterprise settings](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/developers/configuration/merchant-settings/enterprise-settings/)


### Transaction Metadata[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/configuration/merchant-settings/#transaction-metadata "Direct link to Transaction Metadata")
  * **Payment Metadata:** Custom fields for payment tracking.
  * **Refund Metadata:** Custom fields for refund tracking.


### Sender Information for Communication Channels[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/configuration/merchant-settings/#sender-information-for-communication-channels "Direct link to Sender Information for Communication Channels")
  * **Sender Email Addresses**
  * **Phone Numbers**


### Reports[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/configuration/merchant-settings/#reports "Direct link to Reports")
  * **Enable payout reports:** `payoutReportsEnabled`
  * **Enable transaction-level fee reports:** `transactionLevelFeeReportEnabled`
  * [Reports](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/developers/add-on-services/reports/introduction/)


* * *
## Best Practices[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/configuration/merchant-settings/#best-practices "Direct link to Best Practices")
  * Double-check all required fields before submitting onboarding requests.
  * Use the checklist to ensure no step is missed.
  * Store sensitive information securely and comply with data privacy regulations.
  * Review [webhook configuration](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/configuration/) and [reporting options](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/developers/add-on-services/reports/introduction/) for full integration.


* * *
## Troubleshooting & Support[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/configuration/merchant-settings/#troubleshooting--support "Direct link to Troubleshooting & Support")
  * If you encounter issues during onboarding, consult the [Trouble-Shooting Guide](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/developers/trouble-shooting/).
  * For API integration details, see the [Convenient Checkout API documentation](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/developers/convenient-checkout-api/).


* * *
For further assistance, contact the support team or refer to the [Developer Documentation](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/developers/getting-started/).


# Payments
This document describes the webhook events related to payments and their structures.
Quick Reference
  * [Supported Events](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/payments/#supported-events) - List of all payment webhook events
  * [Event Structure](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/payments/#event-structure) - Core structure of webhook event payloads
  * [Payload Structure](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/payments/#payload-structure) - Details of the payload object
  * [Data Structures](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/payments/#data-structures) - Reference for all data structures
  * [Sample Events](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/payments/#sample-events) - Example JSON payloads for different payment events


warning
In the event that payment is captured and succeeded, we will be publishing two events: PAYMENT_SUCCEDED and PAYMENT_SUCCEEDED.
PAYMENT_SUCCEDED will be deprecated by **06/15/2024** and only PAYMENT_SUCCEEDED will be published going forward.
## Supported Events[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/payments/#supported-events "Direct link to Supported Events")
**Supported Events**
Event Type | Description | Applicable payment method types  
---|---|---  
PAYMENT_SUCCEEDED | Emitted when payment is captured and is successful. | CARD, BANK_ACCOUNT  
PAYMENT_SUCCEDED | Emitted when payment is captured and is successful. **`Will be deprecated** ` | CARD, BANK_ACCOUNT  
PAYMENT_FAILED | Emitted when a payment fails. | CARD, BANK_ACCOUNT  
PAYMENT_ACCEPTED | Emitted when a payment is submitted successfully and is being processed. | CARD, BANK_ACCOUNT  
PAYMENT_AUTHORIZED | Emitted when a payment is AUTHORIZED. Authorized payment should be captured later using capture endpoint to complete the payment. | CARD  
PAYMENT_CANCELED | Emitted when a payment is canceled. | CARD, BANK_ACCOUNT  
## Event Structure[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/payments/#event-structure "Direct link to Event Structure")
**Event Structure**
Field | Type | Valid values | Description  
---|---|---|---  
name | Enum | PAYMENT_SUCCEEDED, PAYMENT_FAILED, PAYMENT_ACCEPTED, PAYMENT_AUTHORIZED, PAYMENT_CANCELED | Event name  
source | string | Max length 50 | Indicates the X-source header value received in API request  
payload | [Payload](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/payments/#payload-structure) |  | Event Payload  
## Payload Structure[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/payments/#payload-structure "Direct link to Payload Structure")
**Payload Structure**
Field | Type | Valid values | Description  
---|---|---|---  
amount | long | 50 - 99999999 | Amount (in cents) requested for payment  
authorizedAmount | long | 50 - 99999999 | (PRE_AUTH) Maximum amount approved for capture (in cents); Starting R27, pre-authorization and partial-authorization, should infer this field to consider authorized amount; Prior to R27, infer `amount` field;  
capturedAmount | long | 50 - 99999999 | (SALE) Amount(in cents) immediately settled. (PRE_AUTH) Amount(in cents) successfully captured.  
partialAuthorization | boolean | true/false | (PRE_AUTH) Indicates whether a partial authorization was requested.  
description | string | Max length 50 | Payment Description  
id | uuid | valid uuid4 | Payment Identifier  
merchantId | uuid | valid uuid4 | Merchant Identifier  
merchantTransactionId | string | Max length 50 | MerchantTransactionId sent by the merchant with original payment request  
paymentDateUtc | date | Date in ISO string format | Payment completed datetime  
paymentMethod | [PaymentMethod](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/payment-methods/#paymentmethod-structure) |  | Paymentmethod Description  
error | [Error](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/payments/#error-structure) |  | Error Information  
consent | [Consent](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/payments/#consent-structure) |  | Consent required for bank account payments  
agent | [Agent](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/payments/#agent-structure) |  | Agent Description

# Refunds
Refund events are sent when a refund is processed. Refunds can be processed for both CARD and BANK_ACCOUNT payment methods. There are two types of refunds that can be processed i.e., `linked` and `unlinked` refunds.
  * **Linked refunds** are **processed against a payment** and unlinked refunds are processed without a payment.
  * In case of **unlinked refunds** i.e., credit / cashback, **payment method id** is needed to process the refund.


## Supported Events[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/refunds/#supported-events "Direct link to Supported Events")
Event Type | Description | Applicable payment method types  
---|---|---  
REFUND_SUCCESS | Emitted when refund is successful. | CARD, BANK_ACCOUNT  
REFUND_FAILED | Emitted when a refund fails. | CARD, BANK_ACCOUNT  
REFUND_PENDING | Emitted when a refund status is pending. | CARD, BANK_ACCOUNT  
## Event Structure[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/refunds/#event-structure "Direct link to Event Structure")
Field | Type | Valid values | Description  
---|---|---|---  
name | Enum | REFUND_SUCCESS, REFUND_FAILED, REFUND_PENDING | Event name  
source | string | Max length 50 | Indicates the X-source header value received in API request  
payload | [Payload](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/refunds/#payload-structure) |  | Event Payload  
## Payload Structure[​](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/refunds/#payload-structure "Direct link to Payload Structure")
Field | Type | Valid values | Description  
---|---|---|---  
amount | long | 50 - 99999999 | Refund amount in United States Cents  
reason | String | Max length 50 | Refund reason  
refundId | uuid | valid uuid4 | Refund Identifier  
Payment | [Payment](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/refunds/#payload-structure) |  | Payment Details  
merchantTransactionId | String | Max length 50 | MerchantTransactionId sent by the merchant with original refund request  
merchantId | uuid | valid uuid4 | Merchant Identifier  
metadata | String | Max length 50 | Client provided additional metadate  
paymentMethod | [PaymentMethod](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/payment-methods/#paymentmethod-structure) |  | Paymentmethod Description  
customer | [Customer](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/refunds/#customer-structure) |  | Customer Description  
error | [Error](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/refunds/#error-structure) |  | Error Information  
status | String | COMPLETED and FAILED | Refund Status  
agent | [Agent](https://developers.healthsafepay.com/docs/v1/developers/add-on-services/webhooks/refunds/#agent-structure) |  | Agent Description
